job.title: Assistant Mechanic
job.location: Bell Lane, St Albans, AL2 1DR, GB
job.html_description:
The Role

We’re looking for an Assistant Mechanic to play a vital role in maintaining and enhancing the machinery and equipment that supports our Sobha Realty Training Centre. You’ll be part of our Stadium Management team, ensuring our grounds operations run reliably and efficiently.

This is a hands‑on, fast‑paced role where you’ll take pride in the upkeep and performance of specialist turf care machinery. Working closely with our Head Mechanic and Head Grounds Person, you will utilise your mechanical expertise, problem‑solving mindset and proactive approach to keep our facilities at their very best.

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking). 

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Maintain and service club machinery - you’ll ensure all equipment operates safely, efficiently and in line with manufacturer specifications

  • Keep accurate maintenance records - you will consistently maintain detailed logs of servicing, repairs and inspections to support long‑term planning

  • Support breakdown response - you’ll respond quickly and effectively to unexpected issues, making sure machinery is fit for purpose after repair

  • Collaborate with manufacturers and partners - you will liaise with suppliers to arrange servicing, parts and specialist repair work where needed

  • Champion workshop organisation and safety - you’ll actively maintain a tidy, efficient workspace and follow all relevant health and safety regulations to ensure workshop compliance

  • Assist with maintenance planning - you will work closely with the Head Mechanic on strategies to maintain machinery health and maximise machinery lifespan

  • Manage tools, stock and consumables - you’ll help oversee inventories, fuel supplies and workshop resources in a cost‑effective way

  • Support with wider team training - you will help train others on machinery use and safety, sharing knowledge and fostering a supportive, team‑focused culture

 

What we are looking for

  • Mechanical expertise - you come with Level 3 Agricultural Technician training or significant workshop experience, with advanced machinery maintenance skills

  • Turfcare machinery knowledge - you’re knowledgable and confident in your experience with sports turf or amenity landscape equipment

  • Health and safety awareness - you possess a solid understanding of health and safety regulations, manual handling, COSHH and wider compliance requirements

  • Excellent problem‑solving ability - you're comfortable to diagnosing faults, responding to breakdowns and finding effective long‑term solutions to mitigate future issues

  • Exceptional communication skills - you’re well‑versed in collaborating with colleagues, coaching staff and external partners effectively

  • Proactive and flexible approach - you’re comfortable adapting to varied tasks and working patterns, including occasional weekend callouts

  • Competence with physical requirements - you’re able to meet the manual and physical demands of this role, including operating equipment and handling materials

  • A full clean UK driving licence - you hold a clean UK driving license and you’re able to travel between our locations when required

Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 

Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

Application Closing Date - Sunday 15th November 2026

Please note: we reserve the right to close the position early if application volumes are particularly high. We encourage you to get your application in sooner rather than later.

Updates on the status of your application will be sent via email, please routinely check your spam and junk folders, as occasionally emails sent via the Teamtailor platform will find themselves there.

Good luck!

job.title: Academy Player Care Manager (U9-U16)
job.html_description:
The Role

We're looking for an Academy Player Care Manager (U9-U16) to join our Academy Operations team and play an important role in supporting the wellbeing, development and Academy experience of our young players. Working closely with players, parents, schools, host families and multidisciplinary colleagues, you'll provide individual player care support across the Under 9 to Under 16 age groups while helping to create a challenging and caring environment.

You'll lead key player care programmes, support successful transitions through the Academy pathway, and ensure players and families receive the guidance and support they need at every stage of their development. You'll contribute to creating a positive and supportive environment where young players can thrive and develop both on and off the pitch.

Who we are

We are one of the most famous clubs in world football, with a rich heritage and history of success – read more about our history, here.

Beyond that, we are passionate about our local community and, behind the scenes, we have a wide variety of opportunities and career paths for all. We have a very defined purpose: to act for a winning team, culture and community. We achieve this by ensuring we are courageous in the pursuit of progress, we champion our community and each other, and that we do the right thing (even when no one is looking).

 

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed to ensuring that our environments for children, young people and adults at risk remain safe and inclusive. We therefore require successful candidates to complete a DBS check and other essential background checks prior to starting their employment. Depending on the responsibilities of the role, a DBS will be either a basic, standard, or enhanced check.

Your day-to-day

  • Support our young players and families - you'll build positive relationships with players and parents, providing tailored support and acting as a key point of contact when required

  • Lead player development programmes - you will coordinate and deliver the Academy Transition Strategy and Lifelong Learner Programme, providing engaging life skills and personal development opportunities

  • Manage the Host Family Programme - you'll recruit, support and maintain relationships with host families, coordinating placements and ensuring a positive experience for players

  • Promote player wellbeing - you will support wellbeing initiatives, coordinate appropriate support and contribute to an environment that enables players to flourish

  • Maintain player care records - you'll ensure information is accurate, organised and managed confidentially while supporting wider reporting requirements

  • Collaborate with key stakeholders - you will work closely with Academy staff, families and external organisations to support player development and resolve issues effectively

  • Coordinate inductions and transitions - you'll support players and families through key Academy transitions and deliver annual induction activities

  • Support Academy events and wider initiatives - you'll contribute to tours, tournaments and wider player care projects across the Academy

Position of Trust - As someone in a position of trust role involving regular, direct contact with children or vulnerable adults you will be expected to uphold high standards of conduct to prevent abuse, including sexual, physical, or emotional harm. This role requires you to keep updated with both Club and FA Safeguarding training and education

 

What we are looking for

  • Experience supporting children, young people and families - you can demonstrate a track record of providing welfare-focused support and building trusted relationships

  • Outstanding stakeholder management skills - you're able to communicate effectively and build positive relationships with a range of internal and external contacts

  • Experience working within multidisciplinary teams - you're comfortable collaborating with colleagues from different departments to achieve shared objectives

  • Excellent organisational and administrative skills - you can manage programmes, maintain records and balance competing priorities effectively

  • Knowledge of safeguarding practices - you understand the importance of safeguarding policies, procedures and responsibilities when working with young people

  • An understanding of the football development environment - you ideally hold knowledge of the youth development frameworks and Academy operations

  • Confident IT skills - you're comfortable using Microsoft 365 and maintaining accurate administrative records

  • A caring, proactive and trustworthy approach - you build trust quickly, handle sensitive matters with discretion and positively contribute to team culture

Why choose us

At Arsenal, we want everyone to feel a sense of trust and belonging, so we are proud of both our club values and also what we offer to our employees. As one of our Gunners, you will receive:

  • An exciting reward and recognition scheme

  • Generous holiday allowance which increases with your length of service

  • Great internal learning and development programmes

  • A flexible hybrid working model

  • Priority access to apply for match tickets

  • A competitive health and wellbeing benefits package

  • A leading Employee Assistance Programme

  • Great discounts with some of our Partners

  • An opportunity to play a vital role in delivering our ED&I strategy by joining one of our Employee Networks

Discover why ‘Our Gunners’ are proud to be part of our team - view their stories here.

Arsenal for Everyone

Arsenal for Everyone is our commitment to promoting and embracing equality, diversity and inclusion, so that everyone connected to the club feels like they belong to the same Arsenal family. We believe that diversity of background, skills and experience drives our success on and off the pitch. 

Disability Confident Leader

We are a Disability Confident Leader. We actively welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions. If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a ‘disabled person’ according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below. The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment decisions.

job.title: Human Resources Assistant
job.html_description:
Job Purpose

To deliver a highly confidential, comprehensive and effective HR service through the administration of key HR processes. You will assist in providing generalist, day-to-day HR support in relation to all HR operations in a busy and fast-paced working environment, supporting the Human Resources Advisor with a wide range of HR activities and providing effective HR administration.

The HR department supports the HR function for all business, First Team, Academy and Women’s team staff, as well as the wider Black Knight Football Group when required.

This fixed-term role has been created to meet increased operational demands resulting from temporary departmental changes. We are looking for a self-motivated individual with a positive, hands-on approach who is eager to build their experience and develop a broad understanding of Human Resources in a fast-paced environment.

Employee Relations
  • Provide answers to HR-related queries or provide general advice as directed by the HR Advisor.
  • Process the offboarding of staff members.
  • Support the HR Advisor to co-ordinate and deliver the monthly staff newsletter.
  • Support formal HR meetings through note-taking, document preparation and administrative co-ordination.
Recruitment & Onboarding
  • Assist with all recruitment and retention activities in line with safer recruitment and EDI requirements, including monitoring the jobs inbox.
  • Process new starters and conduct pre-employment checks.
Reward and Recognition
  • Help the HR Advisor deliver and co-ordinate rewards and recognition activities.
Learning and Development
  • Help co-ordinate and organise the delivery of the Club’s Learning and Development schedule.
Casual Workers
  • Assist the HR Advisor in the HR management of all casual workers across the Club.
  • Deliver administrative support to ensure the Club is compliant with casual worker requirements.
HRIS & HR Records
  • Support the HR team in maintaining up-to-date and compliant HR records and databases.
  • Collate and provide payroll updates to the Finance team.
  • Support the HR Advisor with research, benchmarking and data-gathering activities.
  • Prepare documentation and information to support policy reviews and updates.
Mental Health and Wellbeing
  • Provide administrative support to the Mental Health First Aiders Group / Mental Health Lead.
  • Maintain communication channels regarding mental health and wellbeing.
  • Become Mental Health First Aid trained.
General
  • Support the HR Advisor with any ad-hoc tasks required.
  • As a member of staff, ensure that in all matters you follow and actively promote the Club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the Club.
  • As a member of staff, ensure that you adhere to the Club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all.

Essential
  • Basic understanding of, or willingness to learn, HR policies, procedures and employment law.
  • Willingness to learn and develop HR knowledge and skills.
  • Ability to work independently and use initiative appropriately.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload effectively.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Understanding of the importance of confidentiality and data protection.
  • Professional, diplomatic and discreet approach.
  • Strong work ethic with a proactive attitude.
  • Adaptable and receptive to change.
  • Confident, resilient and approachable.
  • Proficient IT skills, including intermediate-level Microsoft Office applications.
Desirable
  • CIPD Level 3 qualification or working towards it.
  • Experience using HR systems (e.g. Pinpoint, StaffSavvy or Sentry).
  • Experience supporting employee wellbeing or mental health initiatives.
  • Qualified Mental Health First Aider.
  • Free onsite parking.
  • Season ticket and allocation of complimentary/purchased tickets (subject to eligibility and availability).
  • Subsidised lunches and complimentary healthy snacks throughout the day.
  • Discounts at the Club Superstore.
  • Access to Health Cash Plan with Simplyhealth.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Contribution towards eye tests and glasses.
  • Discounts and benefits from partners and local businesses.
  • Club pension and Life Assurance Scheme.
  • Paid parental leave (bank of five days per year).
  • Club events or other social events throughout the year run by our Club social team.
  • Paid volunteer opportunities (2 days per year).
  • Paid day’s leave on your birthday.

job.title: Academy Driver (Casual)
job.location: AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre, Wimborne, Wimborne, Dorset
job.html_description:
To transport Academy players to and from all Academy activity, around Bournemouth and nationally.

Academy Values: 
  • Players First: every player valued. Every decision made with care. 
  • Togetherness: working in a prosocial manner as part of a wider team – willing to contribute beyond own interests. 
  • Integrity: carrying out academy and club values in an open and honest manner. 
  • Accountability: willing to take responsibility for actions in a manner which allows learning, growth and reflection. 

  • Transport Academy Players from various pick-up points in the Bournemouth area to and from AFC Bournemouth Performance Centre. Pick up points include but are not limited to: Vitality Stadium, Bournemouth Train Station, Player Accommodation.  
  • Be available to transport Academy players to venues around the country for away fixtures at weekends. 
  • To be available to transport Academy players to other venues as and when needed. 
  • Liaise with the Academy Operations & Player Care teams around weekly schedules and bus registers.  
  • Daily & weekly vehicle checks to be undertaken prior to any journey. Any faults are to be reported in the first instance to the Academy, and maintain the cleanliness of the vehicles. 
  • Provide transport for Academy Players in a safe and lawful manner, fully compliant with the Highway Code and other regulations applying to passenger and minibus transport.  
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. 
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. 
  • Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures.
  • As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Valid UK Driving Licence, including D1 
  • Experience in driving 17-seater minibuses 
  • Experience in driving sports teams or young people (desirable)

Pick up points include but are not limited to: Vitality Stadium, Bournemouth Train Station, Player Accommodation. - Be available to transport Academy players to venues around the country for away fixtures at weekends. - To be available to transport Academy players to other venues as and when needed. - Liaise with the Academy Operations & Player Care teams around weekly schedules and bus registers. - Daily & weekly vehicle checks to be undertaken prior to any journey. Any faults are to be reported in the first instance to the Academy, and maintain the cleanliness of the vehicles. - Provide transport for Academy Players in a safe and lawful manner, fully compliant with the Highway Code and other regulations applying to passenger and minibus transport. - As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters, you follow and actively promote the club’s mental health policies and practices to ensure an open, non-judgmental and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. - As a casual member of staff to ensure that you to adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club. - Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures. - Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures. - As a casual member of staff to ensure in all matters you follow and actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.

job.title: Concourse Bar Staff (Casual)
job.html_description:
We are recruiting staff to serve food, confectionery, hot /cold drinks, etc.
 The shifts are approx. 4 - 6 hours home match day only (usually Saturday ko. 3.00pm.).
Staff will be expected to work at a fast pace as we only have a smalltime frame to serve the supporters.

The stadium is very busy on a match day but there is a good atmosphere within the team and you get to know the supporters.

Experience is a bonus, but not essential as full training given onsite.
  • Duties include using tills, recording information, replenishing stock, ensuring your work area is clean and tidy.
  •  You will also be expected to handle food this can include an element of cooking.
  •  You will be expected to work as part of a team as there are 22 concourse bars and kiosk around the stadium.
  • Customer care is very important to us, so you will be expected to be polite and helpful to all individual customers..
  • As a casual worker you must adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.

  • Actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club.

job.title: Ball Runner Coordinator (Casual)
job.html_description:
We are looking for someone to join the Club on a casual matchday role. They will be responsible for coordinating and supporting Ball Runners, ensuring they are effectively managed, safeguarded, and prepared to contribute to the smooth operation of AFC Bournemouth home fixtures.
  • Attend designated home fixtures and oversee all Ball Runner activities. 
  • Deliver pre-match briefings to ensure Ball Runners understand their roles, responsibilities, and expected behaviours. 
  • Allocate positions around the pitch in accordance with competition and Club requirements. 
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Ball Runners on matchdays. 
  • Liaise with Match Officials, Operations Staff, Safety team as required. 
  • Ensure the safety and wellbeing of all Ball Runners at all times. 
  • As a casual worker you must adhere to the club’s safeguarding policies and procedures and are committed to our safeguarding values, creating a safe and positive environment for all those who interact with the club.  
  • Obligation to adhere to the club’s health and safety policy and procedures.  
  • Actively promote the club’s equality policies and practices to ensure a welcoming, safe and inclusive environment for everyone engaged with the club. 
  • Responsibility to comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005, and all related Company policies, taking reasonable care for their own safety and that of others, reporting hazards or incidents, following safe systems of work, and co-operating with all training and emergency procedures.

The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands.
  • Experience working with children and young people. 
  • Strong organisational and communication skills. 
  • Ability to lead and manage groups of young people. 
  • Understanding of safeguarding responsibilities when working with children. 
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in a busy matchday environment. 
  • Reliable, punctual, and able to work evenings and weekends. 
  • Willingness to complete training as directed by the Club. 
  • Good understanding of football and matchday operations (desirable) 
  • FA Safeguarding Children qualification (desirable) 
  • This role involves working with children and young people and is therefore subject to the successful completion of an Enhanced DBS check and satisfactory safeguarding checks.

job.title: Chef de Partie (Part Time)
job.html_description:
Join Manchester City Women in a key culinary role supporting elite athletes with high-quality, performance-focused food preparation. Based at the Women’s 1st Team Facility in Manchester, this part-time role offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment focused on player wellbeing, recovery and performance.

 

Who We Are

At Manchester City Women, we are proud to be part of City Football Group and one of the leading clubs in women’s football, competing at the highest level in the Women’s Super League, domestic cups, and European competition. Based at the Etihad Campus in Manchester, our team is built on ambition, innovation, and a commitment to excellence both on and off the pitch. We are passionate about developing the women’s game, inspiring the next generation of players and fans, and fostering an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

Our Women’s Team facility team plays an important role in creating a high-performance environment where players and staff can thrive. From daily preparation to match travel support, the team works collaboratively to deliver an exceptional experience that supports health, wellbeing and performance.

The Role

As Chef de Partie, you will support the delivery of nutritious, high-quality meals tailored to the needs of elite athletes and staff. Working closely with the Head Chef, Sous Chef and Nutrition team, you will help ensure food preparation and presentation consistently meets the highest professional standards.

You will contribute to menu development, support smooth day-to-day kitchen operations and help maintain excellent hygiene and food safety practices. The role also includes supporting stock management, reducing waste and maintaining kitchen equipment and service areas.

This is a collaborative role where flexibility and teamwork are essential, including supporting domestic and international travel where required to provide team-standard catering services.

What You’ll Bring

⚽ Experience preparing and presenting food within a professional hospitality or elite sporting environment
⚽ Strong communication and customer service skills with the ability to build positive working relationships
⚽ Knowledge of food safety standards, including HACCP and Food Safety Level 3

⚽ Ability to organise workloads, manage priorities and adapt positively in a fast-paced environment
⚽ Creativity and attention to detail when preparing and presenting food
⚽ Experience supporting stock control, supplier management and minimising food waste

 

Why Choose Us

Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site, we encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

Based at the Women’s 1st Team Facility in Manchester, this part-time role offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment focused on player wellbeing, recovery and performance.
Who We Are
At Manchester City Women, we are proud to be part of City Football Group and one of the leading clubs in women’s football, competing at the highest level in the Women’s Super League, domestic cups, and European competition. Based at the Etihad Campus in Manchester, our team is built on ambition, innovation, and a commitment to excellence both on and off the pitch. We are passionate about developing the women’s game, inspiring the next generation of players and fans, and fostering an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.
Our Women’s Team facility team plays an important role in creating a high-performance environment where players and staff can thrive. From daily preparation to match travel support, the team works collaboratively to deliver an exceptional experience that supports health, wellbeing and performance.

As Chef de Partie, you will support the delivery of nutritious, high-quality meals tailored to the needs of elite athletes and staff. Working closely with the Head Chef, Sous Chef and Nutrition team, you will help ensure food preparation and presentation consistently meets the highest professional standards.
You will contribute to menu development, support smooth day-to-day kitchen operations and help maintain excellent hygiene and food safety practices. The role also includes supporting stock management, reducing waste and maintaining kitchen equipment and service areas.

job.title: Stadium Finance Manager
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this full-time, 18-month maternity cover role will take full responsibility for the financial performance of a defined area of Manchester City’s stadium commercial operations. You will turn financial data into clear insight, build trusted relationships across the business and help colleagues make timely decisions across ticketing, hospitality, catering and major stadium events. Working in a collaborative hybrid environment with a minimum of three days per week in the office, you will be expected to respond quickly and thoughtfully as business priorities change.

 

 

Who We Are

 

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Commercial Finance team supports the financial management of matchday and non-matchday revenue across the stadium. Working closely with colleagues in ticketing, hospitality, catering and events, the team provides the insight, challenge and planning needed to help Manchester City make informed commercial decisions and deliver memorable experiences for our Fans and visitors.

 

 

The Role

 

 

As Stadium Finance Manager, you will own the financial support for your area of Manchester City’s stadium revenue generation. You will be fully responsible for understanding performance, identifying opportunities and helping stakeholders make timely decisions across ticketing, hospitality, catering and non-matchday events, including concerts and future major events such as Euro 2028 activity.

 

You will lead the co-ordination of budgets and forecasts across matchday areas, oversee P&L management and monitor product performance and margins. Your role will be to make financial information clear and accessible, listen carefully to the needs of colleagues, and provide practical insight that supports action. As the business changes, you will need to react quickly, reassess priorities and help the area respond with pace and good judgement.

 

The role is also responsible for managing and developing a Finance Analyst. You will build constructive, trusting relationships with a broad range of stakeholders, communicate financial findings with empathy and confidence, and work closely with the Finance Business Partner – Stadium Finance to support the department’s objectives and long-term plans. Your ability to collaborate, influence and create clarity will be as important as your technical finance capability.

 

 

What You’ll Bring

 

 

⚽ Relevant finance capability gained through an accounting qualification, relevant degree or equivalent practical experience.

⚽ Experience applying commercial finance expertise to budgeting, forecasting and P&L management.

⚽ Data analysis capability, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and the ability to turn financial information into useful insight.

⚽ Clear, thoughtful communication skills, including the ability to explain financial information in an accessible way to different audiences.

⚽ Collaborative stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, listen, influence and work effectively across a commercial environment.

⚽ A proactive, adaptable and solutions-focused approach, with the ownership to manage your area, react quickly to business changes and deliver accurate, high-quality work to agreed deadlines.

 

 

Why Choose Us

 

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

 

How to Apply

 

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 6th November. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

The recruitment process will begin with a Talent Acquisition sift and hiring manager review. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a 30-minute Teams interview and asked to complete a task provided in advance. Finalists will then attend a 45–60 minute interview on site in Manchester.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

 

Equal Opportunities

 

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Visitor Attractions Commercial Operations Manager
job.html_description:
Based at the Etihad Stadium in Manchester, this permanent, full-time role will lead the commercial performance of Manchester City’s Visitor Attractions. You will shape secondary-spend activity, improve customer propositions and connect teams across the wider Medlock Square destination to create more valuable, seamless visitor journeys. With responsibility for commercial initiatives, supplier relationships and the souvenir photography operation, you will help turn insight and ideas into measurable revenue and an excellent visitor experience.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

Within Visitor Attractions, we create memorable experiences for visitors across Stadium Tours, the Museum and related attractions. Our team brings together visitor experience, operational delivery and commercial thinking to help people connect with the Club while supporting the continued growth of the wider Medlock Square destination.

 

The Role

 

As Visitor Attractions Commercial Operations Manager, you will own the delivery of secondary-spend performance across areas including souvenir photography, guidebooks and vending. You will develop practical plans against agreed targets, monitor sales, conversion and spend per visitor, and use customer and operational insight to identify opportunities that improve commercial return.

 

You will act as a key commercial link between Visitor Attractions and Hotel, Food and Beverage, Conferences and Events, Product, Sales, Marketing and other teams across Medlock Square. Working with the right stakeholders, you will coordinate cross-selling, referrals and bundled propositions, helping to turn agreed ideas into simple, bookable customer journeys that work across relevant channels and touchpoints.

 

You will also lead the souvenir photography operation and team, manage relevant suppliers, support guidebook and other sales initiatives, and provide clear reporting, forecasting and commercial insight. By balancing revenue performance with high-quality service, you will help shape the visitor experience, improve ways of working and support future product and operational decisions.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience in commercial operations, retail, visitor attractions or another customer-focused sales environment.

⚽ Experience leading and supporting a team to deliver sales and customer-service outcomes.

⚽ Direct experience of sales, upselling, customer conversion and secondary-spend activity.

⚽ Ability to contribute commercial insight to product development and improve customer-facing propositions.

⚽ Experience managing budgets, P&L performance or commercial targets, with confidence using numerical and sales data to identify opportunities.

⚽ Clear communication, organisation and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives and work with external suppliers.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 15 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: UAE Football Coach - Manchester City Football Education UAE
job.html_description:
Closing Date: 8 November 2026 
Assessment Date: 14 November 2026, 8am-12pm at City Football Academy, Manchester

 

Based in the United Arab Emirates, this full-time opportunity offers coaches the chance to take their career onto a global stage with Manchester City. You will help deliver high-quality coaching programmes while developing your own coaching identity within a diverse and fast-growing football environment. It is an opportunity to learn, grow and contribute to a world-class football organisation, gaining international experience while making a meaningful impact on player development.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Football Education team delivers programmes around the world, bringing Manchester City’s coaching philosophy to life across a range of environments. In the UAE, our programmes continue to grow, offering coaches the chance to work in a dynamic, multicultural setting while supporting the development of players of all abilities.

 

The Role

 

You will join a collaborative coaching team delivering programmes that reflect Manchester City’s coaching philosophy, standards and approach. Working across a range of age groups and abilities, you will help create engaging, high-quality sessions that support both player development and enjoyment of the game.

 

Alongside delivery, you will contribute to the ongoing development of programmes by supporting session planning, reviews and continuous improvement. You will work closely with colleagues to ensure consistency in delivery, while also adapting your approach to meet the needs of different players and environments.

 

You will also play an important role in representing Manchester City both on and off the pitch, building positive relationships with players, families and local stakeholders, and contributing to wider programme activations across the region.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ FA Level 2 or UEFA C coaching qualification (minimum)
⚽ Membership of a recognised FA or international equivalent
⚽ Experience delivering coaching sessions within a football environment
⚽ Ability to communicate clearly and build positive relationships with players and colleagues
⚽ Experience working with players from a range of backgrounds and abilities
⚽ Commitment to learning, development and continuous improvement

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

This role offers a comprehensive international relocation package, including housing, medical cover, transport allowance, flights and visa sponsorship, alongside the opportunity to gain valuable global coaching experience.

 

Find out more about our UAE programs

    https://www.mancity.com/city-football-schools/abu-dhabi-cup/venue

    https://www.mancity.com/city-football-schools/abu-dhabi-league
  • Manchester City Football Schools – UAE
    https://www.mancity.com/learn-football/football-school-united-arab-emirates

 

Follow us

 

  • Man City Abu Dhabi League
    https://www.instagram.com/cityabudhabileague/profilecard/?igsh=Z3UzcjlwbzBid21p
  • City Football Schools – UAE
    https://www.instagram.com/cityfootballschools/profilecard/?igsh=MTZ2bDlwZHplM3Y2
  • Man City Abu Dhabi Cup
    https://www.instagram.com/abudhabicup

 

How to Apply

 

If you’re ready to take the next step in your coaching career and explore an international opportunity with Manchester City, we’d love to hear from you. Please click apply and submit your application via our careers site by 8 November 2026.

 

The assessment day will take place on Saturday 14 November at City Football Academy, Manchester.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

job.title: Casual Academy Physiotherapist
job.html_description:
Based at the City Football Academy in Manchester, this casual opportunity supports the health, wellbeing and on-pitch development of high-potential Academy players. You will provide responsive physiotherapy support across training and matchday activity, helping players recover well, reduce injury risk and return safely to full function within an elite development environment.

 

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within the Manchester City Academy, our multidisciplinary team supports young players throughout their development pathway. Medical, performance and coaching colleagues work together to provide thoughtful, evidence-based care that promotes player wellbeing, availability and long-term development on and off the pitch.

 

 

The Role

 

As a Casual Academy Physiotherapist, you will contribute to the assessment and management of injuries, helping to optimise recovery and minimise time away from football. You will also support screening and injury-prevention activity, applying current clinical practice to meet the individual needs of Academy players.

 

Working alongside the wider medical and performance team, you will help deliver rehabilitation plans that support a safe return to full function. You will provide emergency aid cover at training sessions and matches and maintain the professional registration, pitch-side trauma accreditation and clinical standards required for the role.

 

Clear communication will be central to your impact. You will work effectively with full-time colleagues, players, parents and coaches, while contributing to continuous professional development across the Academy therapy team. Casual assignments may be offered at short notice and can include evenings, weekends and other irregular hours.

 

 

What You’ll Bring

 

 

  • A degree in Physiotherapy, Sport Rehabilitation or Sports Therapy
  • Current HCPC or BASRaT registration appropriate to your professional discipline
  • Current ITMMiF Level 4 pitch-side trauma qualification, or a higher equivalent qualification
  • Ability to support injury assessment, rehabilitation and injury-prevention activity in a player-centred way
  • Clear and effective communication skills when working with players, parents, coaches and multidisciplinary colleagues
  • Flexibility to accept casual assignments at short notice, including evenings, weekends and other irregular hours

 

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working with Manchester City means being supported to contribute your expertise in an environment built on collaboration, openness and high standards of care. You will have the opportunity to support talented young players at important stages of their development and see the direct impact of thoughtful, evidence-based practice.

 

This casual position offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced medical, performance and coaching colleagues within an elite Academy setting. Each assignment is a chance to broaden your experience, share knowledge and contribute to a multidisciplinary approach that places player wellbeing and long-term development at its centre.

 

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 6 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Casual Football Coach - UK Football Education
job.html_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this casual role offers the chance to support Manchester City Football Education by delivering high-quality coaching sessions for players of diverse ages and abilities. You will help create a positive, organised and development-focused environment while building your experience with support from senior coaches.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within Manchester City Football Education, we create engaging coaching experiences that support player development and inspire a lifelong love of the game. Our coaching environment is built on high standards, positive relationships and continuous learning, with a shared focus on helping players enjoy quality sessions and progress with confidence.

 

The Role

 

In this casual coaching role, you will support the preparation, delivery and review of sessions aligned to the Manchester City coaching curriculum and methodology. You will work with players of different ages and abilities, helping to create an environment that is welcoming, professional and focused on development.

 

You will deliver sessions across weekends, evenings and school holidays, while receiving mentoring and training that supports your own growth as a coach. You will also contribute to quality assurance by maintaining high standards of delivery, communication and session preparation.

 

This is a role for those who enjoy working independently and as part of a wider coaching team, with a clear focus on positive player experiences, consistency and professional conduct. You will act as a positive role model and ambassador for Manchester City, helping to ensure players, parents and colleagues receive a high-quality experience at every session.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Minimum UEFA C or equivalent coaching qualification
⚽ Experience coaching in education, community or club settings
⚽ A relevant higher education qualification, or equivalent professional experience
⚽ Commitment to ongoing CPD, including safeguarding awareness and DBS compliance
⚽ Clear and effective communication skills with players, parents, coaches and stakeholders
⚽ Proven ability to plan, deliver and review coaching sessions that support player development across age groups

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As a casual coach, you will also benefit from flexible working arrangements, ongoing mentoring and training, and the chance to build on your experience in a supportive coaching environment.

job.title: Sports Medicine Lead - Manchester City Women
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent role is available full-time or on a reduced-hours basis, with a minimum commitment of 0.6 FTE. You will provide comprehensive medical care across Manchester City Women’s First Team and Girls’ Academy, with a particular focus on supporting the First Team. You will help players access high-quality assessment, treatment and recovery pathways, while contributing to the medical standards, wellbeing and performance of the wider football programme.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.

 

Within our Performance Services department, we support the health, wellbeing and performance of Manchester City Women players across the first team and Girls Academy. Working as part of a collaborative medical and sports science environment, we help create the conditions for players to develop, perform and sustain their careers.

 

The Role

 

You will provide medical care for first-team players and Girls Academy players aged 8 to 19, leading on the assessment, investigation, treatment and management of injury and illness. You will also support required medical assessments, screening and profiling, contribute to pre-signing medicals, and provide pitch-side cover at home and away fixtures, including international competitions where required.

 

You will be a proactive member of the multidisciplinary team, contributing to diagnosis, treatment planning and return-to-play decisions. The role will lead the illness audit and help develop prevention strategies, education resources and timely communication plans, while also supporting player wellness and appropriate referral for mental health concerns.

 

You will establish and lead Emergency Medical Action Plans across training, match and travel environments, including for the Academy, and help maintain high standards of clinical governance. By working closely with performance staff, coaches, players, external consultants and football leadership, you will support regulatory compliance, clear communication and an effective medical service across the programme.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Full registration with the General Medical Council.
  • Currently on the GMC specialist register for Sport and Exercise Medicine, General Practice or any other relevant medical speciality.
  • Membership (MFSEM) or Fellowship (FFSEM) of Faculty of Sport and Exercise Medicine.
  • Advanced capability in clinical examination, functional assessment, musculoskeletal imaging and the medical management of injury and illness in high-performance sport.
  • Experience delivering medical services to high-performance athletes.
  • Experience working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team in high-performance sport.
  • Experience supporting young adults in an elite sporting environment.
  • Ability to reflect on clinical practice, adapt when needed and communicate with care. Strong integrity, humility and professionalism. Contribute effectively to clinical governance and compliance with relevant regulations.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

job.plain_text_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent role is available full-time or on a reduced-hours basis, with a minimum commitment of 0.6 FTE. You will provide comprehensive medical care across Manchester City Women’s First Team and Girls’ Academy, with a particular focus on supporting the First Team. You will help players access high-quality assessment, treatment and recovery pathways, while contributing to the medical standards, wellbeing and performance of the wider football programme.
Who We Are
Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.
Within our Performance Services department, we support the health, wellbeing and performance of Manchester City Women players across the first team and Girls Academy. Working as part of a collaborative medical and sports science environment, we help create the conditions for players to develop, perform and sustain their careers.
The Role
You will provide medical care for first-team players and Girls Academy players aged 8 to 19, leading on the assessment, investigation, treatment and management of injury and illness. You will also support required medical assessments, screening and profiling, contribute to pre-signing medicals, and provide pitch-side cover at home and away fixtures, including international competitions where required.
You will be a proactive member of the multidisciplinary team, contributing to diagnosis, treatment planning and return-to-play decisions. The role will lead the illness audit and help develop prevention strategies, education resources and timely communication plans, while also supporting player wellness and appropriate referral for mental health concerns.
You will establish and lead Emergency Medical Action Plans across training, match and travel environments, including for the Academy, and help maintain high standards of clinical governance. By working closely with performance staff, coaches, players, external consultants and football leadership, you will support regulatory compliance, clear communication and an effective medical service across the programme.
What You’ll Bring
- Full registration with the General Medical Council. - Currently on the GMC specialist register for Sport and Exercise Medicine, General Practice or any other relevant medical speciality. - Membership (MFSEM) or Fellowship (FFSEM) of Faculty of Sport and Exercise Medicine. - Advanced capability in clinical examination, functional assessment, musculoskeletal imaging and the medical management of injury and illness in high-performance sport. - Experience delivering medical services to high-performance athletes. - Experience working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team in high-performance sport. - Experience supporting young adults in an elite sporting environment. - Ability to reflect on clinical practice, adapt when needed and communicate with care. job.title: Youth Development Phase Coach
job.html_description:
Based at the City Football Academy in Manchester, this permanent, full-time role supports coaching and player development within Manchester City’s Youth Development Phase. Working alongside the lead age-group coach, you will help deliver engaging training and matchday experiences that enable young players to progress individually and collectively within the Club’s football philosophy.

 

 

Who We Are

 

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within Manchester City Academy, the Coaching team creates an integrated environment for young players to develop technically, tactically, physically and psychologically. Coaches work closely with colleagues across the Academy, as well as players’ parents and guardians, to support each stage of the pathway.

 

 

The Role

 

 

You will support the lead age-group coach in planning and delivering high-quality training sessions and matchday coaching for players in the Youth Development Phase. Through thoughtful, age-appropriate coaching, you will help players develop the understanding and skills needed to succeed within the Manchester City style of play.

 

You will contribute to individual learning plans and development programmes that address technical, tactical, physical and psychological needs. By observing each player carefully and adapting your coaching, you will support their progress, help them transition between age groups and reinforce positive behaviours within the team environment.

 

Collaboration is central to the role. You will work with coaches, multidisciplinary Academy colleagues, scouting and recruitment teams, and players’ parents or guardians. You will also contribute across other Academy age groups when required and support delivery in line with the Club’s EPPP strategy.

 

 

What You’ll Bring

 

 

  • A current UEFA B Licence.
  • An FA Youth Award.
  • Experience coaching players within the Youth Development Phase in an Academy environment.
  • Ability to identify, develop and support football talent through age-appropriate coaching and individual learning plans.
  • Knowledge of Youth Development Phase player development and the ability to solve problems and collaborate within a multidisciplinary team.

 

 

 

Why Choose Us

 

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

 

How to Apply

 

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 9 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

 

Equal Opportunities

 

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

job.title: Football Education Coach
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this fixed-term full-time role will help deliver engaging, high-quality football education programmes at the City Football Academy and external sites across the city. You will bring the Manchester City coaching philosophy to life, creating safe and positive learning experiences that support participants’ development and help our programmes continue to improve.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within our Football Education team, we deliver programmes at the City Football Academy and external sites across Manchester. The team works collaboratively to provide enjoyable, development-focused experiences for participants of different ages, while continually learning from players, parents and colleagues to improve programme quality.

 

The Role

 

You will support the planning, preparation and delivery of Manchester-based football education programmes, embedding the Manchester City coaching philosophy, methodology and City Play Model curriculum in every session. Your coaching will help participants develop in a safe, enjoyable and positive environment, with each activity tailored to the aims of the programme.

 

Alongside weekly sessions, you will contribute to fixtures, festivals and other events at the City Football Academy and external venues. You will also support programme administration and communication, helping colleagues, parents and other stakeholders stay informed about delivery requirements and participant development.

 

You will use equipment and technology thoughtfully to enhance the player experience, gather and interpret stakeholder feedback, and contribute practical ideas that improve our programmes. From time to time, you may also support wider Football Education activity elsewhere in the UK or internationally.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ An FA coaching qualification at UEFA B level, or active progress towards this qualification.

⚽ Experience in football or sports coaching delivery, supported by practical programme administration skills.

⚽ Knowledge of City Football Group methodology with the ability to coach participants across age groups in training and competitive settings.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to work positively with colleagues, parents and other stakeholders.

⚽ Knowledge and understanding of the football and sports industry.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 9 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted with details of the next steps in the recruitment process.

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.
