job.title: Facilities Supervisor (Etihad Stadium)
job.html_description:
Based at the Etihad Stadium in Manchester, this permanent Facilities Supervisor role plays a key part in keeping the site safe, welcoming and operating to a high standard for colleagues, partners and visitors. Working on a 5 days over 7 pattern with regular evenings and weekends, you will help deliver excellent facilities support across a busy multi-use environment. This is an exciting opportunity that will include the delivery of Premier League, UEFA fixtures and concerts at the Etihad Stadium.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Facilities Management team helps keep the Etihad Stadium and wider site ready for the many different demands of each day and each season. From maintaining safe, clean and welcoming spaces to supporting matchday preparation, contractor coordination and guest standards, the team plays an important part in creating a professional environment that works for everyone who uses it.

 

The Role

 

This role sits at the heart of day-to-day site operations, helping to make sure facilities services are delivered to a high standard and that the building environment supports colleagues, partners and customers. You will help maintain the quality, safety and consistency of the site, bringing a practical and thoughtful approach to the work that keeps everything running smoothly.

 

Your focus will include daily checks and operational support across cleaning, health and safety, building maintenance, grounds, security and energy management. You will also help coordinate planning and day-to-day use of the site, support accommodation standards, contribute to audits and inspections, and work alongside others to make sure facilities meet the needs of a varied and busy environment.

 

You will work closely with colleagues, partners and contractors, helping to build positive relationships and support continuous improvement across the site. The role also involves supporting the wider Facilities Management team on meetings, events, infrastructure projects and matchday or safety-related activity when required, so flexibility, good judgement and clear communication are important throughout.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience in facilities management or a similar supervisory role within a multi-faceted building or operational environment.

⚽ Ability to supervise and support cleaning, security or other site service teams to maintain high standards.

⚽ Clear and effective communication skills, with the confidence to influence colleagues, contractors and stakeholders.

⚽ Good computer literacy, with the ability to maintain records, complete administration and produce reports accurately.

⚽ Ability to manage day-to-day operations, follow procedures and contribute to continuous improvement.

⚽ A good standard of education or relevant qualifications, with the flexibility to work a 5 days over 7 pattern including regular evenings and weekends.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 11th November 2026 We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Our interview process begins with an application review by our Talent Acquisition team, followed by a first-stage interview, usually via Microsoft Teams, to meet the team and explore the opportunity. Next is a face-to-face interview with a task-based assessment to showcase your skills. If required, a final stage may offer the chance to meet wider teams, explore our facilities and experience life at CFG!

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. job.title: Facilities Manager
job.html_description:
Based at the Etihad Stadium in Manchester, this permanent, full-time role helps create a safe, reliable and welcoming environment for everyone who uses the site. You will coordinate essential facilities services, support consistently high operational standards and help ensure that employees, Fans, partners and visitors can enjoy a well-managed stadium environment.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Facilities team supports the safe and effective operation of the Etihad Stadium. Working across a wide range of services and with colleagues, contractors and partners, the team helps maintain an environment that meets the needs of employees, customers and everyone who visits the site.

 

The Role

 

You will support the Senior Facilities Manager in coordinating the day-to-day delivery of facilities services across the Etihad Stadium. Your work will help maintain a safe, secure and high-quality operational environment, with careful attention to compliance, safeguarding, inclusion and the experience of people using the site.

 

You will oversee activity across cleaning, waste and recycling, building maintenance, grounds maintenance, security and energy management. Through inspections, audits, performance measures and practical follow-up, you will help contractors meet agreed standards and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. You will also support site planning and facilities projects, ensuring that work is well coordinated and that the quality of provision meets operational needs.

 

Collaboration will be central to the role. You will build effective working relationships with partners, stakeholders and colleagues to understand their needs and provide suitable facilities solutions. As a site key holder and member of the emergency call-out team, you will also help ensure the stadium remains available for safe and efficient operation when required.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽Experience coordinating facilities management services such as cleaning, waste and recycling, logistics, building maintenance, grounds or estate management.

⚽Ability to monitor contractor performance through inspections, audits, agreed measures and practical improvement actions.

⚽A practical understanding of health and safety compliance and its application within an operational environment.

⚽Comfortable using facilities management software and standard digital tools to maintain records, complete administration and produce reports.

⚽Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to build collaborative relationships and influence positive outcomes.

⚽Ability to organise priorities, work independently when needed and take part in site key-holder and emergency call-out arrangements.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 11 November. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Our interview process begins with an application review by our Talent Acquisition team, followed by a first-stage interview, usually via Microsoft Teams, to meet the team and explore the opportunity. Next is a face-to-face interview with a task-based assessment to showcase your skills. If required, a final stage may offer the chance to meet wider teams, explore our facilities and experience life at CFG!

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Social Media Producer - Manchester City Women's
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester with a hybrid working pattern, this new full-time permanent role offers the opportunity to shape how Manchester City Women connects with Fans and reaches new audiences. Dedicated to the women’s team, you will create distinctive, platform-first content that brings football, player personalities and the matchday experience to life, including coverage at home and away matches.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.

 

Within our Media team, this role will spend meaningful time embedded with Manchester City Women and work closely with the Women’s Marketing team. Together, we create content that grows audiences, strengthens fan connection, supports match attendance and wider commercial goals, and maintains high editorial and brand standards.

 

The Role

 

Dedicated to Manchester City Women, you will build trusted working relationships with players and staff so content feels natural and distinctive. By balancing football coverage with personality-led, lifestyle and fan-focused storytelling, you will help existing supporters feel closer to the team and introduce it to new audiences.

 

You will take content from concept and filming through editing, approval, publishing and community engagement across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X and emerging channels. From training and behind-the-scenes moments to live updates and key football action, you will also showcase the atmosphere, community and entertainment at the Joie Stadium, Etihad Stadium and away fixtures. The role includes working at home and away matches, including evenings and weekends as required.

 

Working collaboratively with the Social Media Manager, fellow producers, the Content Lead and the Women’s Marketing team, you will develop joined-up content plans and bring the evolved Manchester City Women brand to life. You will use audience insight and performance data to improve content, identify emerging trends and maintain accuracy, editorial judgement and brand consistency across day-to-day publishing and community engagement.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽Experience taking engaging social media content from concept through filming and editing to publication and community engagement.

⚽Clear understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and X, with the ability to use platform insight and analytics to improve performance.

⚽Skilled in vertical video editing, photography and social media production.

⚽Creative storytelling and copywriting skills, supported by clear editorial judgement and an understanding of media law.

⚽Knowledge of women’s football and its evolving audiences, with an interest in lifestyle, entertainment and popular culture.

⚽Ability to build trusted working relationships and collaborate effectively, with availability for home and away matches, including evenings and weekends as required.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 13 November. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Our interview process begins with an application review by our Talent Acquisition team, followed by a first-stage interview, usually via Microsoft Teams, to meet the team and explore the opportunity. Next is a face-to-face interview with a task-based assessment to showcase your skills. If required, a final stage may offer the chance to meet wider teams, explore our facilities and experience life at CFG!

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Journalist
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester with a hybrid working pattern, this full-time permanent role offers the opportunity to bring Manchester City stories to life for fans around the world. As a Journalist in our Editorial team, you will create accurate, engaging content across our digital platforms, helping audiences feel closer to the Club, its teams and its history.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Editorial team brings Manchester City stories to life, giving fans across the world an informed and engaging view of the Club every day. Working within Media, the team produce high-quality news and feature writing for web, app, digital magazine and matchday programmes, provide match coverage across men, women, EDS and U18s games, while supporting colleagues across video, social and design

 

The Role

 

You will produce high-quality editorial that helps fans follow Manchester City. From breaking news and features to live blogs, match reports and interviews, your work will be accurate, engaging and suited to each platform and audience. Alongside day-to-day editorial delivery on web and app, you will contribute copy for the digital magazine and matchday programmes. You will support sub-editing and apply SEO and website best practice so stories are easy to find and presented at their best.

 

Working closely with editorial leaders, you will help shape the daily news agenda, develop new content ideas and maintain reliable records of statistics and milestones. You will also build constructive relationships with former players, managers and staff, helping the wider Media team tell informed stories across channels.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽A professional journalism qualification and experience working on a news desk.

⚽Proven ability to write accurate, engaging copy to deadline, including live match coverage.

⚽Experience using a content management system to publish and maintain digital content.

⚽In-depth knowledge of Manchester City’s men’s, women’s, EDS and U18 teams.

⚽Ability to build and maintain professional contacts with former Manchester City players, managers and staff.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 13 November. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Our interview process begins with an application review by our Talent Acquisition team, followed by a first-stage interview, usually via Microsoft Teams, to meet the team and explore the opportunity. Next is a face-to-face interview with a task-based assessment to showcase your skills. If required, a final stage may offer the chance to meet wider teams, explore our facilities and experience life at CFG!

job.title: Community Coach - Schools
job.html_description:
Community Coach – Schools

This Community Coach – Schools role is an opportunity to inspire children and young people across Greater Manchester through sport and education. Working closely with schools, teachers and colleagues, you will deliver engaging and inclusive sessions that help pupils develop confidence, improve their physical wellbeing and build skills for the future.

 

Who We Are

Established in 1986, City in the Community is Manchester City’s official charity. We support people across Manchester by empowering healthier lives through football. Our programmes place physical and mental wellbeing at their core, whilst also creating healthy futures and healthy communities.

Within our Schools team, we use sport and physical activity to create positive learning experiences for children and young people across Greater Manchester. Through our Primary Schools and Disability Schools programmes, we work closely with schools and teachers to deliver inclusive PE, support pupil development and help young people of all abilities build confidence and reach their potential.

 

The Role

You will deliver high-quality coaching and education sessions across City in the Community's Primary Schools and Disability Schools programmes, supporting pupils through National Curriculum PE, Premier League Primary Stars and inclusive physical activity.

Day to day, you will plan and deliver engaging, structured and inclusive sessions that support pupils' physical development, confidence and enjoyment of sport. Working closely with the Primary Schools Officer or Disability Schools Officer, you will help ensure programmes meet curriculum objectives and provide a safe, positive learning environment for all participants.

Alongside programme delivery, you will build strong relationships with teachers and school staff, monitor pupil progress and contribute to programme reporting. You will also play an important role in maintaining high safeguarding standards and ensuring CITC and CFG policies are embedded across all activities.

 

What You'll Bring

⚽ A minimum NGB Level 2 Coaching qualification in any sport (excluding dodgeball).

⚽ Experience delivering coaching or education sessions within schools, with knowledge of the National Curriculum.

⚽ Experience working with children and young people, delivering engaging and inclusive activities.

⚽ Strong behaviour management skills, with the ability to create a positive learning environment.

⚽ Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with a creative and adaptable approach to delivery.

⚽ A full UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle.

 

Why Choose Us

Guided by our values of being caring, inclusive, transformative and youth-led, we are committed to creating an environment where our team feel supported, valued and able to make a meaningful difference through the work they do every day.

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 16th November 2026.

 

Equal Opportunities

City Football Group is committed to achieving workforce diversity and we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, national origin, race, age, sex, gender identity, disability - physical or hidden, sexual orientation, veteran status, religious belief, or any other characteristics protected by law. We strive to provide a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage all applicants to reach out if they require any support or accommodation to enable them to thrive throughout our recruitment process. Please contact citcjobs@cityfootball.com.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: UK and UAE Football Education Coach Opportunities - London Recruitment Day
job.html_description:
Join Manchester City Football Education at our London recruitment day and explore two coaching pathways: a casual variable-hours role based in the UK, or a full-time opportunity in the United Arab Emirates. Taking place at Hertfordshire Sports Village in Hatfield on Sunday 15 November 2026 from 12:00pm to 4:30pm, this event is an opportunity to demonstrate your coaching approach and be considered for the role, or roles, that best match your experience and plans.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Manchester City Football Education creates engaging coaching experiences that support player development and inspire a lifelong love of the game. Across our UK and international programmes, we bring the Manchester City coaching philosophy to life through positive relationships, thoughtful session design and a shared commitment to helping players of different ages and abilities enjoy the game and progress with confidence.

 

The Role

 

This London recruitment day brings together two distinct opportunities within Manchester City Football Education. You may ask to be considered for the UK casual role, the full-time UAE role, or both.

 

UK casual opportunity. Based in the UK, you will prepare, deliver and review sessions aligned with the Manchester City coaching curriculum and methodology. Working across weekends, evenings and school holidays, you will create welcoming, organised and development-focused experiences for players of different ages and abilities. You will receive mentoring and training while contributing to consistent delivery, effective communication and professional standards.

 

UAE full-time opportunity. Based in the UAE, you will deliver programmes that reflect Manchester City's coaching philosophy across a range of age groups and abilities. You will support planning, review and continuous improvement, adapt sessions to the players and environment, and build positive relationships with players, families, colleagues and local stakeholders. You will also represent Manchester City through wider programme activity across the region.

 

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • A minimum UEFA C, FA Level 2 or equivalent coaching qualification
  • Experience planning and delivering football coaching sessions in an education, community or club environment
  • Proven ability to adapt coaching for players from different age groups, backgrounds and abilities
  • Clear and effective communication skills with players, families, colleagues and other stakeholders
  • Commitment to ongoing learning, safeguarding and the professional standards relevant to the selected opportunity

 

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

Benefits are aligned to the opportunity. The UK casual role offers flexible working arrangements, ongoing mentoring and training, and the chance to build your experience in a supportive coaching environment.

 

The UAE role offers a comprehensive international relocation package, including housing, medical cover, a transport allowance, flights and visa sponsorship, alongside the opportunity to gain international coaching experience in a multicultural environment.

 

How to Apply

 

If this opportunity sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 12 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

In your application, please state whether you would like to be considered for the casual UK opportunity, the full-time UAE opportunity, or both.

 

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to the London assessment on Sunday 15 November 2026. The assessment will take place from 12:00pm to 4:30pm at Hertfordshire Sports Village, De Havilland Campus, Mosquito Way, Hatfield Business Park, Hatfield, AL10 9EU.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment for the UK casual opportunity is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: People Services Coordinator
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this role plays an important part in keeping City Football Group’s people operations running smoothly. You will help deliver accurate and timely HR administration across starters, leavers, employee changes, payroll activity, benefits and HR systems, supporting colleagues across the People team and the wider business.

 

Who We Are

 

Founded in 2013, City Football Group is the world’s leading private owner and operator of football clubs, with teams across the globe connected by a shared belief in doing things differently. Alongside our clubs, we invest in football-related businesses and build partnerships that help the game, and the communities around it, thrive. Everything we do is guided by our purpose: empowering better lives through football. Rooted in more than a century of “City” football, we are proud of the role our clubs play locally and globally, creating positive impact on and off the pitch.

 

Within our People Services team, we provide the day-to-day support that helps employees and managers access accurate, reliable and well-run people processes. This role sits at the centre of that service, helping the team manage key administration, maintain systems and respond to queries with care, professionalism and pace.

 

The Role

 

The People Services Coordinator is a hands-on support role within a busy HR environment, focusing on administration, HR systems and employee support. You will help make sure core people processes run smoothly, accurately and on time, from starters and leavers through to employee changes, benefits updates and payroll input.

 

A large part of the role is keeping information moving correctly through the process. You will manage the People Services inbox, respond to queries, maintain HR systems and support reporting, data checks and deadlines. You will also help coordinate maternity, paternity and shared parental cases, along with other day-to-day people administration that supports the wider team.

 

Working closely with People colleagues, suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will help create a service that is dependable, well organised and easy to work with. The role also gives you the opportunity to support wider projects and continuous improvement, helping the team build efficient processes and a positive experience for employees across City Football Group.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Experience in HR administration within a busy HR environment.
  • Core HR administration knowledge, including starters, leavers and employee changes.
  • Experience inputting payroll data and working to deadlines.
  • Confidence using HR systems, running reports and working with employee data accurately.
  • Comfortable handling confidential information and responding to queries in a professional and helpful way.
  • High attention to detail, with clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across a team.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 15 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: 1st Team Data Scientist
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent role sits within Manchester City’s 1st Team Analysis department and helps turn football data into better decisions. Working with the Football Intelligence Data team, you will develop models and insights that inform recruitment, training and match strategy, while helping football practitioners understand what it takes to perform at the highest level. 

 

Who We Are 

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way. 

 

Within our 1st Team Analysis department, we work across performance analysis and football intelligence to support better decision-making on and off the pitch. By combining technical expertise, football understanding and collaborative ways of working, the team develops practical insight for Manchester City and the wider City Football Group network. 

 

The Role 

 

As a First Team Data Scientist, you will research and build data science solutions that help football practitioners and decision-makers answer important questions about performance and recruitment. Your work will turn complex information into clear, useful insight that can support the way teams prepare, perform and develop. 

 

You will develop statistical and machine-learning models that deepen our understanding of what it takes to perform, contributing to quantitative approaches across technical, tactical and physical areas of football. You will explore patterns and trends, identify meaningful features, test ideas and make predictions that can inform training programmes and match strategies. 

 

Working alongside data scientists, analysts and colleagues across multidisciplinary teams, you will communicate your findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. You will manage your work against agreed plans, contribute to shared project outcomes and bring curiosity, imagination and practical problem-solving to new football performance challenges. 

 

What You’ll Bring 

 

  • A Masters or equivalent industry experience in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science or a related subject. 
  • Experience designing and training complex statistical models. 
  • Proficiency in Python for data analysis and model development. 
  • Experience working with structured and unstructured data sources, including spatio-temporal data. 
  • Clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to present technical findings to non-technical audiences. 
  • Proven ability to collaborate with other data scientists and across multidisciplinary teams. 
 

 

Why Choose Us 

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work. 

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance. 

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs. 

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers. 

 

How to Apply

job.plain_text_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent role sits within Manchester City’s 1st Team Analysis department and helps turn football data into better decisions. Working with the Football Intelligence Data team, you will develop models and insights that inform recruitment, training and match strategy, while helping football practitioners understand what it takes to perform at the highest level.
Who We Are
Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.
Within our 1st Team Analysis department, we work across performance analysis and football intelligence to support better decision-making on and off the pitch. By combining technical expertise, football understanding and collaborative ways of working, the team develops practical insight for Manchester City and the wider City Football Group network.
The Role
As a First Team Data Scientist, you will research and build data science solutions that help football practitioners and decision-makers answer important questions about performance and recruitment. Your work will turn complex information into clear, useful insight that can support the way teams prepare, perform and develop.
You will develop statistical and machine-learning models that deepen our understanding of what it takes to perform, contributing to quantitative approaches across technical, tactical and physical areas of football. You will explore patterns and trends, identify meaningful features, test ideas and make predictions that can inform training programmes and match strategies.
Working alongside data scientists, analysts and colleagues across multidisciplinary teams, you will communicate your findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. You will manage your work against agreed plans, contribute to shared project outcomes and bring curiosity, imagination and practical problem-solving to new football performance challenges.
What You’ll Bring
- A Masters or equivalent industry experience in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science or a related subject.
- Experience designing and training complex statistical models.
- Proficiency in Python for data analysis and model development.
- Experience working with structured and unstructured data sources, including spatio-temporal data.
- Clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to present technical findings to non-technical audiences.
- Proven ability to collaborate with other data scientists and across multidisciplinary teams.
Why Choose Us
Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.
As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.
Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.
You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.
How to Apply
If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 16 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.
We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.
Equal Opportunities
City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.
We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.
All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.
Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Matchday Steward (casual contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

• You must be over 18 (Essential)

• NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (desirable)

• Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners

• Be mature and be able to handle situations calmly

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous

• A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect

• Good communication skills

• An understanding of body search regulations and processes

• Experience working at a football stadium and/or similar spectator events (Desirable)


Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB

Contract Type:   0-hour, Fixed-Term Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15

About this role:

If you have experience in the catering and events industry or a passion for customer service – we want to hear from you! You will be engaging, enthusiastic and have a thirst to learn and grow. You want to be a part of the buzz and excitement of a match day by being the face of Crystal Palace Football Club and providing excellent service to the customers of our many bars and kiosks.

 

Our match days are typically on Saturdays with some weekday evening and Sunday matches and the typical shift day is 6-8 hours depending on the game.


Responsibilities:

  • Take initiative and participate in the set-up of kiosks and bars, stock and supplies

  • Welcome guests and taking orders

  • Process payments on POS devices in an efficient manner

  • Maintain counters and fridges with sufficient supplies of stock throughout the service period, as guided by your manager.

  • Ensure stock rooms and areas are organised and clean, to ensure easy stock rotation and reconciliation.

  • Where necessary, assist in the back of house areas: kitchen and food preparation, pot wash and stock deliveries

  • Perform clean-up duties after each shift and ensure that concession stand is sanitized and tidied to a high standard

  • Serving alcohol responsibly and following the club’s Challenge 25 Policy

  • Adhering to all Health & Safety policies including the club’s Food Safety Management Systems

  • Carrying out any other reasonable duties asked of you from within your team and management including being flexible in covering tasks outside of your role-specific duties.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • A positive attitude and be prepared to help the team

  • Experience in catering, hospitality or food service

  • Strong customer service and communication skills

  • Engaging and easy to talk to

  • Reliable, punctual and trustworthy

job.title: Casual Cleaner
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB | Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:     Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for a self-motivated, detail orientated and hardworking cleaner to join our team. You will be responsible for making sure that the site is clean, presentable. This can entail dusting, polishing, mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, and cleaning smudges off windows and doors.


Responsibilities:

  • Being responsible for all basic cleaning in and around the building.

  • Cleaning floors and rooms - including dust mopping, damp mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, dusting, picking up objects off the floor, and spot cleaning glass and windows.

  • Cleaning restrooms, including restocking dispensers, emptying trash, cleaning and sanitizing fixtures, cleaning mirrors, spot cleaning partition doors and walls, sweeping and mopping tile floors, and cleaning toilets and urinals.

  • Emptying trash, cleaning vacuums and replacing liners

  • Setting up, stocks, and maintains cleaning equipment and supplies.

  • Monitoring and maintaining sanitation and organization of assigned areas.

  • Assisting other departments when needed to ensure optimum service to guests.

  • Liaising with the line manager to ensure that you have sufficient cleaning products at all times.

  • Reporting any breakages that occur during the cleaning process.

  • Informing the line manager of repairs that need to be done.

  • Reporting any large objects obstructing fire exit.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in professional cleaning with exceptionally high standards

  • Attention to detail

  • High standard of discretion and confidentiality

  • Have a strong work ethic, be loyal, passionate, and friendly.

  • Team player – expected to work well and communicate effectively with the team

  • Checkable reference

  • Ability to work with high profile professionals

  • Understanding that our commercial premises may contain confidential paperwork etc

  • Ensuring compliance to sanitation, hygiene, health and safety legislation and organisational and quality requirements and working policies and procedures.

  • Flexible and adaptable at all times

job.title: Matchday Public Catering Chef (casual contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Fixed-Term Contract

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

If you have experience in preparing and cooking hot food or as a grill chef with a passion for customer service – we want to hear from you! You will be engaging, enthusiastic and have a thirst to learn and grow. You want to be a part of the buzz and excitement of a match day by being the face of Crystal Palace Football Club and serving high quality products throughout the match.

Our match days are typically on Saturdays with some weekday evening and Sunday matches and the typical shift day is 8 hours depending on the game.

Responsibilities:

  • Understanding all menus, product offerings, packaging and pricing

  • Responsible for preparing and cooking all the hot food such as burgers, pies, hot dogs nachos and specialty items for a unit on match day and meeting peak periods with appropriate food levels

  • Maintain high standards of food presentation and quality with regular controls

  • Ensure all products are accounted for, prepared and distributed according to cook-off numbers and instructions from your manager

  • Restock and ensure the food prep area is clean at the end of your shift

  • Ensure all kitchen unit equipment (electrical or otherwise) is cleaned down and properly maintained at the end of every shift

  • Adhere and keep up to date records for food and health and safety standards such as food temperature control levels and following the club’s Food Safety Management System

  • Adhering to all Health & Safety policies and Security policies

  • Carrying out any other reasonable duties asked of you from within your team and management including being flexible in covering tasks outside of your role-specific duties.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Food Safety Level 2 certificate and strong knowledge of proper food handling procedures

  • Experience grilling or cooking food in mass quantities, particularly in a busy or similar environment

  • A can-do attitude and be prepared to help the rest of the team out with a positive attitude

  • Immaculate grooming standards and overall appearance

  • Always look for ways to improve

  • Can work in high pressure situations

job.title: Maintenance Operative
job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:     Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract Type:   Full-time


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for an experienced and skilled Maintenance operative to perform and upkeep tasks such as repairs, inspections, plumbing, carpentry, painting, decorating, general maintenance and planned improvement services to our facilitates. The individual will be responsible for assisting other trades when required to ensure the highest level of service across our sites.


Responsibilities:

  • Undertake the day-to-day general maintenance repairs in-house for all our facilities but mainly at our Academy Training Ground.

  • Undertake painting work, such as preparing painting surfaces, removing old paint, mixing and matching paints, and to use correct utilities to prepare the surrounding areas in order to prevent messes.

  • Undertake plumbing work, such as fixing leaks, unblocking drains and gutters, shower fitting, and more.

  • Undertake tiling and decorating work, such as, preparing surfaces by levelling off with the correct material, measuring and applying tiles, repairing/removing old surfaces, add more.

  • Undertake carpentry work, such as taking measurements and installing shelves, cabinets, handles, locks and more.

  • Preparation of the facilities for home matches

  • Regular checks and repairs on lights, toilets, and seats.

  • Completing work in accordance with the Crystal Palace specifications and in compliance with the relevant Legislation and industry best practices

  • Working to operational procedures, safe working practices and Health and Safety procedures as required.

  • Providing general support and assistance to the Maintenance Manager

  • Inspecting the Training ground and Academy and it’s adjoining structures on a daily and weekly basis to ensure they are all well-kept and in order.

  • Completing works at other Crystal Palace Football Club grounds and facilities including the Academy Training Ground.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in a maintenance environment.

  • Experience in plumbing, painting, decorating, carpentry, and general maintenance.

  • Basic knowledge of maintenance systems such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical etc.

  • Ability to read manuals and drawings.

  • Experience using hand and electrical tools.

  • Experience working in large scale stadiums/ buildings.


Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days

job.title: Logistics & Fulfilment Operative (Casual Contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Logistics Operative plays a vital role in supporting the successful delivery of matchdays and events across Selhurst Park. Responsible for the movement, storage and organisation of food, beverages, equipment and disposables, the role ensures kiosks, bars and hospitality areas are fully stocked, organised and operational.

Working as part of the Public Catering team, the Logistics Operative helps maintain high standards of cleanliness, food safety and operational efficiency, ensuring an exceptional experience for supporters, guests and clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Receive, check and store food, beverage and equipment deliveries.

  • Ensure stock is rotated and stored in accordance with company procedures.

  • Support stock counts and stock reconciliation activities.

  • Report shortages, damages and discrepancies to management.

  • Maintain accurate stock records where required.

  • Prepare kiosks, bars and catering areas for operation.

  • Distribute food, beverage, equipment and disposable stock throughout the stadium.

  • Support premium areas and event spaces with operational requirements.

  • Ensure units are replenished efficiently throughout service.

  • Respond quickly and effectively to operational requests during matchdays and events.

  • Maintain cellar areas to a high operational standard.

  • Support beer line cleaning procedures where required.

  • Ensure food stores, disposable stock rooms and chemical storage areas are clean, organised and compliant.

  • Assist with the movement and handling of kegs and heavy stock items using safe working practices.

  • Complete HACCP, delivery, temperature and cleaning records accurately.

  • Follow all Health & Safety, Food Safety, COSHH and manual handling procedures.

  • Maintain high standards of cleanliness throughout operational areas.

  • Report maintenance issues, hazards and incidents promptly.

  • Work closely with the Stock Controller, Hub Leaders and management team to ensure operational requirements are met.

  • Support colleagues across the department where required.

  • Communicate shortages, equipment failures and operational issues promptly.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience working within hospitality, catering, logistics, warehouse or customer-facing environments.

  • Flexible approach to working hours, including evenings, weekends and matchdays.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work independently and use initiative.

  • Previous experience within logistics, cellar operations or stock control. (Desirable)

  • Experience working in a stadium, arena or large-scale event environment. (Desirable)

  • Experience handling food and beverage stock. (Desirable)

  • Level 2 Food Safety Certificate. (Desirable)

  • Manual Handling Certificate. (Desirable)

  • Counterbalance Forklift Licence. (Desirable)

  • Personal Licence Holder. (Desirable)

  • First Aid qualification. (Desirable)

job.title: Matchday Hub Leader (Casual)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £16.67 p/h

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Hub Leader is a senior front-line catering team member responsible for the safe and efficient operation of a designated concession or bar unit on matchdays and events. Acting as the main point of contact within their area, the Hub Leader is responsible for ensuring excellent guest service, accurate stock control and that all team members operate in accordance with Club standards and legal requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the full operation of a designated concession or bar unit from set-up to close-down.

  • Attend pre-match/pre-event briefings and prepare the unit for service.

  • Complete close-down duties and support final counts and cleaning.

  • Liaise with the Concessions Supervisor and management team to ensure the smooth operation of the area.

  • Deliver exceptional service to supporters and guests, including dealing with customer complaints and resolving issues in a professional manner.

  • Promote product knowledge and upselling opportunities.

  • Ensure accurate counting and control of food, beverages and disposables.

  • Ensure stock is handled securely and replenished accurately throughout service.

  • Monitor stock usage during the event and communicate shortages proactively.

  • Record wastage, transfers and returns in accordance with training.

  • Maintain regular communication with the Concessions Supervisor and management team.

  • Communicate shortages, equipment failures and maintenance issues promptly.

  • Escalate concerns proactively to minimise disruption to service.

  • Lead by example while supporting, motivating, and developing team members.

  • Ensure key information is effectively communicated to team members.

  • Ensure food safety, hygiene and operational standards are maintained at all times.

  • Ensure all required documentation is completed accurately and on time.

  • Ensure licensing regulations are followed, with particular attention to Challenge 25 and protecting children from harm.

  • Monitor the correct use of PPE, handwashing and food handling procedures.

  • Ensure products are served to agreed specifications and brand standards.

  • Support stock accuracy and waste reduction initiatives.

  • Complete all paperwork accurately and within required timescales.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in hospitality, retail, catering, or other fast-paced customer-facing environments.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and customer service skills.

  • Ability to work independently, use initiative, and remain calm under pressure.

  • Previous team leader or supervisory experience.

  • Experience with EPOS systems, cash handling, and stock control.

  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays

  • Personal Licence Holder (desirable)

  • Reliable, responsible, and professional, consistently leading by example.

  • Positive and supportive, with the ability to motivate others and remain calm under pressure.

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.
