  • Data Management, Reporting & Analysis: 
    • Accurately input, update and maintain recruitment data across various systems and spreadsheets, ensuring precision and consistency;
    • Build and maintain dynamic/pivot tables to organize and cross-reference recruitment data;
    • Analyze recruitment reports and metrics, critically reviewing data to identify inconsistencies, trends and insights that support decision-making;
    • Prepare clear and well-structured PowerPoint presentations to communicate recruitment data and updates to stakeholders;
    • Update and standardize templates across systems;
  • Manage recruitment systems, tools and templates with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, maintaining up-to-date records of all recruitment information in alignment with internal stakeholders; hiring managers, workforce planning, onboarding and payroll;
  • Analyze resumes, screen and shortlist candidates against role requirements, supporting the recruitment team throughout the end-to-end hiring process; sourcing, screening, interviewing, reference checks, offer support and onboarding;
  • Provide support to functional areas and hiring managers about recruitment policies and procedures, clarifying recruitment processes, tools and workforce plan;
  • Support employer branding actions, raising awareness about FWWC2027 and maximizing candidates' access to job advertisements;
  • Comply with all FIFA and FWWC2027 hiring and recruitment policies and procedures and local legislation.

  • Previous experience in recruitment processes, such as resume screening and candidate assessment, is a plus;
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when working with spreadsheets and data entry; does not need to be an advanced Excel user, but must be highly reliable;
  • Good working knowledge of HR/recruitment systems and applicant tracking systems;

  • Proactive and organized, able to work independently as well as part of a team;

  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills;
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion;
  • Technology: Familiarity with MS Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) is desirable; prior exposure to HR systems and online collaboration tools will be considered a plus;
  • Right to work in Brazil;
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written);
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written);
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Venue Power and Containment Manager – 7 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Power & Containment Cluster Manager, the Venue Power & Containment Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination and delivery of power infrastructure, containment systems and key technical services across assigned FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 venues. The role ensures that power, containment, HVAC, water & waste, floodlighting, sound systems and related services are delivered in full compliance with FIFA standards, supporting operational readiness, safety and broadcast requirements. Working closely with stadiums, host cities, suppliers, Functional Areas and other key stakeholders, the position manages critical dependencies and serves as a key integration point between design, procurement, delivery and operations. Through effective stakeholder coordination, risk management and cross-functional alignment, the role contributes to the successful delivery of venue infrastructure and safeguards the tournament’s critical path.

Key Responsibilities
  • Coordinate and manage technical requirements for power, containment and related services (including HVAC, water & waste and floodlighting) in collaboration with FIFA Functional Areas and key stakeholders, ensuring alignment with operational, broadcast and venue delivery objectives.
  • Manage the appointed Technical Power Provider, ensuring the timely and efficient delivery of all venue power and containment services.
  • Collaborate with FIFA functional areas, Host Broadcast Services (HBS), venue teams, and key stakeholders to define, coordinate, and optimize venue power and containment requirements.
  • Oversee the installation, testing, commissioning, operation, and decommissioning of temporary power systems, including diesel generators, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and containment infrastructure.
  • Support the development and implementation of containment solutions, including routing, layouts, technical documentation, and installation schedules across competition and non-competition venues.
  • Monitor quality, compliance, and operational readiness, ensuring adherence to approved designs, technical specifications, safety standards, environmental regulations, and FIFA requirements.
  • Manage provider contracts and project delivery, including scope of work, design specifications, Bill of Quantities (BoQ), handover processes, and risk mitigation activities.
  • Coordinate system resilience testing, including stress tests and failover exercises, and provide technical support and troubleshooting throughout all event phases.
  • Lead and support venue teams through guidance, knowledge transfer, performance reporting, and the promotion of sustainable, efficient, and cost-effective solutions.
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Right to live and work in Brazil 
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or similar
  • Experience in delivering Power & Containment solutions at Major Events/Sports Organization
  • Experience with MV/LV electrical installation
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions
  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • This position requires that the applicants are based near the Venues that will host the FWWC2027.  
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.

job.title: Volunteer Platform Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager - FIFA27, and working under the functional guidance of the FIFA Volunteer Management team in Zurich, the Volunteer System Manager will make sure the FIFA Volunteer Management Tool is used consistently and to FIFA's established standards across the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™.

FIFA Zurich owns the FIFA Volunteer Management Tool and defines the service levels, processes, and standards applied at every FIFA tournament. The Volunteer System Manager will receive intensive training from FIFA Zurich. The role then transfers these standards to the local edition in Brazil, so that all requirements are understood, adopted, and applied by the local organisation.

A core part of the role is training and supporting system users at FIFA27 Headquarters in Rio de Janeiro and across all eight Host Cities. The role also acts as a key link between the Volunteer team and other Functional Areas and provides regular reporting to local and FIFA Zurich stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Complete intensive onboarding and training with FIFA Zurich on the FIFA Volunteer Management Tool, its processes, and service standards.
  • Apply and maintain FIFA's tournament standards in Brazil, translating and transferring requirements to the local context.
  • Support the implementation of volunteer processes in the tool, from selection and role allocation through to scheduling and tournament-time operations, including test events where applicable.
  • Identify local requirements or challenges and escalate them to FIFA Zurich, contributing to agreed solutions rather than independently changing system set-up.
  • Train FIFA27 HQ and Host City volunteer teams on the use of the FIFA Volunteer Management Tool, using materials and guidelines provided by FIFA Zurich.
  • Adapt training materials to the local context and language (Portuguese), in alignment with FIFA Zurich.
  • Deliver Train-the-Trainer sessions so that Host City teams can support their own users.
  • Act as the first point of contact for local user questions and issues, resolving them where possible and escalating to FIFA Zurich as required.
  • Manage user access requests and validations in line with FIFA processes.
  • Act as the link between the Volunteer team and other Functional Areas to support data exchange and aligned processes.
  • Coordinate with FIFA Zurich on dependencies with other FIFA and local systems.
  • Participate in testing activities (e.g., UAT, simulations, readiness exercises) as coordinated by FIFA Zurich.
  • Produce regular reports and status updates for the Senior Volunteer Manager, Host City teams, and FIFA Zurich, using agreed formats and tools.
  • Monitor data quality and completeness in the tool and follow up with local teams on corrections.
  • Ensure data is handled in line with FIFA data protection standards and Brazilian legislation (LGPD).
  • Provide on-the-ground system support to HQ and Host City teams during the tournament, in coordination with FIFA
    Zurich.
  • Support close-out activities, including data clean-up, handover, and input into the debrief report.
Responsibilities of the role will likely evolve during the lifespan of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, and the successful candidate should be supportive and flexible to additional requirements.
  • Strong experience in volunteer, workforce, or sport event operations, ideally involving systems or databases.
  • Experience using volunteer or workforce management systems; experience with Rosterfy is a strong advantage.
  • Proven experience delivering training to diverse user groups.
  • Strong organisational and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical processes clearly.
  • Good analytical and reporting skills (e.g., Excel; Power BI or similar is a plus).
  • Comfortable working within established frameworks and following guidance from a central team, while proactively raising issues and ideas.
  • Detail-oriented, reliable, and service-minded.
  • Collaborative team player, comfortable in a multicultural, fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for sport, community, and volunteering.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel Regulatory Governance & Compliance
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Handle all matters concerning regulatory governance, in particular in relation to the FIFA Statutes and the FIFA Governance Regulations, and cooperate with the Member Associations Governance and Services Department in governance matters of Member Associations.
  • Provide substantial comments and feedback to regulatory projects, legal documents and general matters related to all FIFA Regulations, commentaries/explanatory notes, memos and similar.
  • Provide responses to regulatory enquiries from all internal and external football stakeholders.
  • Handle complex investigations into possible breaches of FIFA Regulations, notably the FIFA Regulations on the Status and Transfer of Players, FIFA Football Agent Regulations, FIFA Clearing House Regulations, and others.
  • Gather and assess evidence, prepare case files and reports for disciplinary proceedings before the FIFA judicial bodies.
  • Have an active role in the general management of such investigations: drafting correspondence, reports, methodology guidelines, setting up a database of relevant decisions and jurisprudence, and actively participating in working groups to improve the efficiency and legal accuracy of the processes, among others.
  • Monitor the international transfer system and the activities of all involved stakeholders for possible breaches of FIFA Regulations.
  • Manage and supervise administrative cases of minor infractions.
  • Develop and administer compliance education programs for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop creative approaches to tackle non-compliant behaviours, including through cooperation with external stakeholders and organisations.
  • Research and analysis of the jurisprudence of FIFA and CAS.
  • Mentor other team members, advising on substantive legal matters, as well as efficient ways to allocate time and resources. 


We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • At least 5 years post-qualification experience, either in a law firm, sports governing body, football stakeholder or sports organisation.
  • Accuracy and detail orientation, combined with a pragmatic approach when solving problems.
  • Autonomy and excellence, positively impacting the efficiency and quality, resulting in an optimal service to the stakeholders.
  • Strong sense of responsibility and accountability.
  • Critical judgement: ability to separate essential issues from side-issues and to set the right priorities when allocating resources to investigate regulatory breaches.
  • Self-confidence and diplomacy.
  • Solution orientation and innovation skills, with great ability to embrace changes and new technologies and processes.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Proficiency in at least one other FIFA language (F / ES).
  • Proficient use of MS Office Applications.
  • Readiness for stand-by duties.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Material Planning & Dissolution Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Sitting within the Operational Services Department, Logistics (along with Guest Operations, Language Services, Accommodation, Transport, and Travel) aims to deliver the most engaging, innovative, and accessible World Cup experience for all athletes, fans, partners, and the community.   

The Material Planning and Dissolution Coordinator for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ will collaborate with internal stakeholders to gather and consolidate their Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment (FF&E) needs into a centralized system. This role ensures that all FF&E requirements are effectively managed throughout the planning and execution phases. The coordinator will focus on continuous optimizations, smooth handling of changes, and ensuring that all FF&E needs are met efficiently and sustainably. During the operations phase, the coordinator will work closely with other logistics workstreams to ensure the timely delivery of materials to the required destinations. 

Also, the Material Planning and Dissolution Coordinator will lead the materials procurement and dissolution strategy for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, and other related events organized by FIFA (events). This strategy focuses on managing materials effectively for a successful tournament, emphasizing sustainability and cost efficiency. The coordinator will reduce and reuse materials where possible and develop robust dissolution plans to avoid excess items post-tournament, ensuring a seamless and efficient event.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Collaborate with venue teams to develop comprehensive material plans and layouts, ensuring alignment with stakeholder needs and requirements. 
  • Capture stakeholder needs and material requirements, ensuring all specifications are accurately documented and integrated into the planning process. 
  • Utilize the Material Planning System or other Material Logistics Database to capture and manage all relevant information accurately, ensuring data integrity and accessibility for all stakeholders. 
  • Establish long-term relationships and exceptional customer service for stakeholders, guiding them through the planning process and educating them on the Material Planning System or other Materials Logistics Database to enhance their understanding and efficiency. 
  • Work with Finance, Procurement, and vendors to identify and implement special requirements for returning or disposing of materials, such as recycling or donation programs. 
  • Oversee the logistics related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ dissolution phase, ensuring the efficient and timely movement of materials. 
  • Coordinate the return or disposal of materials from venues to supplier warehouses or disposal sites. 
  • Establish and maintain relationships with disposal and recycling partners to ensure the environmentally responsible disposal of materials. 
  • Relevant experience in Supply Chain or Logistics. 
  • Experience in Events is a plus. 
  • Strong customer service focus. 
  • Excellent analytical skills and ability to make decisions independently and within a team environment. 
  • Extremely high attention to detail. 
  • Team player, comfortable in upward/downward communication and wanting to go the extra mile. 
  • Ability to present and communicate to audiences in many public/private settings as required. 
  • Proven track record in participating in complex projects, multi-tasking, and prioritization of tasks and deliverables. 
  • Willing to work to complex, tight, immovable timelines while maintaining a positive attitude, exhibiting patience, persistence, and experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-national environment. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Tax Manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.


These are your key tasks:

Core Tax Compliance and Reporting
  • Prepare FIFA's annual Swiss tax calculation.
  • Review FIFA's Swiss tax return prepared by external advisors. 
  • Oversee and review FIFA's international tax compliance obligations.
  • Lead the preparation and filing of Country-by-Country (CbCr) reporting together with the support of external advisors.
  • Support the withholding tax documentation process.
  • Prepare and maintain the Group tax compliance calendar.
  • Support and/or lead tax filings, responses to tax authority inquiries, and tax audits.
  • Support the Internal Audit function in assessing and monitoring tax risks.
Tournament Tax Operations & Compliance 
  • Support the Tax team in assessing tax obligations arising in connection with international tournaments and events.
  • Support the tax implementation in tournament host jurisdictions.
  • Assist in the preparation of tax handbooks, guidance materials, and communications for key stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain tools used to calculate, monitor and report tax obligations arising from payments.
  • Coordinate the collection, validation, and reporting of information required in tournament host jurisdictions.
  • Oversee tax compliance obligations for key stakeholders in collaboration with external advisors.
  • Support transfer pricing compliance and related intercompany matters.
Group tax strategy and tax planning
  • Support and/ or lead the analysis of new tax legislation and regulatory developments, assess their impact on FIFA and Group entities, define resulting obligations, and support implementation across the Finance function globally.
  • Support the calculation of group effective tax rates and the preparation of tax forecasts.
  • Assist in the development, maintenance, and implementation of Group tax policies.
  • Support the identification and implementation of tax optimization opportunities aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify and drive improvements in tax compliance processes, reporting, and documentation.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • 6-8 years of experience in corporate taxation, international tax, or tax advisory roles.
  • Experience overseeing international tax compliance obligations across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience supporting tax audits, tax authority inquiries, and regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Strong project management skills 
  • Demonstrated experience working with external tax advisors and managing tax-related projects.
  • Experience with transfer pricing, Country-by-Country (CbCr) reporting, and international tax frameworks is highly desirable.
  • University degree or equivalent higher education in Taxation, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field.
  • Professional tax qualification (e.g. Swiss Tax Expert, Chartered Tax Adviser, Certified Tax Adviser, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent) is strongly preferred.
  • Fluent in English.  Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French, Spanish, or German) is an asset.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and exercise sound professional judgement. 
  • Experience with tax reporting, tax compliance, and financial reporting systems.
  • Strong data analysis and modelling capabilities.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Production specialist
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:

In-House printing production
  • Run and schedule the in-house print facility (digital and large-format printing, finishing, binding) to meet deadlines.
  • Maintain equipment and consumables, and set quality standards for all finished output.
  • Handle urgent, last-minute print requests for events, often same-day.
  • Track costs and turnaround time, and uphold health and safety standards in the print area.
Merchandise order coordination
  • Create and deliver on-brand print and digital assets, from concept to final production.
  • Support events, campaigns, and internal communications with high-quality creative solutions.
 Corporate internal online shop (External Partner Management)
  • Act as main point of contact for the vendor operating the corporate online shop. 
  • Brief new products, manage the catalogue, and approve artwork before launch.
  • Monitor service levels and fulfilment, and run regular performance reviews with the vendor.
 Graphic design
  • Create on-brand print and digital assets.
  • Prepare and review production-ready artwork.
  • Deliver design solutions for events, campaigns, and internal communications. 
General
  • Manage supplier relationships and support contract discussions.
  • Track production status, costs, and performance metrics.
  • Resolve operational issues and support junior team members or freelancers.
  • Provide support during major events, including outside standard working hours.

We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • 3-5 years of experience in print production and graphic design.
  • Proven ability to deliver in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.
  • Experience managing external suppliers or agencies. 
  • Experience in sport, events, entertainment, or similar industries is an asset.
  • Native/Fluent in English
  • Working proficiency in German
  • Professional-level command of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) or equivalent design tools. 
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining print production equipment.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce or online shop administration platforms is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent vocational qualification in graphic design, print media, production, or a related field.
  • Highly organised, able to work autonomously across multiple concurrent orders and deadlines.
  • Commercially aware, with sound judgement on cost and quality trade-offs.
  • Clear, confident communicator, comfortable briefing designers, suppliers and senior stakeholders.
  • Calm under pressure, hands-on and detail-oriented.
  • Thrives under tight, last-minute deadlines; reprioritizes quickly when urgent requests arise.
  • Flexible and available to support events outside standard hours when required.
  • Collaborative team player who takes ownership and follows through.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.

  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

- 3-5 years of experience in print production and graphic design. - Proven ability to deliver in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments. - Experience managing external suppliers or agencies. - Experience in sport, events, entertainment, or similar industries is an asset. - Native/Fluent in English - Working proficiency in German - Professional-level command of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) or equivalent design tools. - Hands-on experience operating and maintaining print production equipment. - Familiarity with e-commerce or online shop administration platforms is a plus. - Bachelor's degree or equivalent vocational qualification in graphic design, print media, production, or a related field. - Highly organised, able to work autonomously across multiple concurrent orders and deadlines. - Commercially aware, with sound judgement on cost and quality trade-offs. - Clear, confident communicator, comfortable briefing designers, suppliers and senior stakeholders. - Calm under pressure, hands-on and detail-oriented. - Thrives under tight, last-minute deadlines; reprioritizes quickly when urgent requests arise. - Flexible and available to support events outside standard hours when required. - Collaborative team player who takes ownership and follows through.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
- Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym. - Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all. - Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth. - Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it. - Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions. - Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation. - Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport. - Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance. - Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Venue Overlay Coordinator – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Venue Overlay Manager, the Overlay Coordinator will be a key member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 Technical Services team. The Overlay Coordinator plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure at an assigned venue. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.


Key Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and key stakeholders to define, optimize, and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  • Monitor the execution of overlay contracts in collaboration with the Venue Overlay Manager;
  • Assist the Venue Overlay Manager by managing change control and budget tracking, ensuring scope, cost, and schedule alignment;
  • Coordinate and oversee the flow of technical information, including drawings, requirements, and updates, for the assigned venue;
  • Assist the Venue Overlay Manager by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades;
  • Coordinate overlay delivery from planning through construction, operations, and reinstatement, ensuring quality, compliance, and timely handover;
  • Track progress, milestones, and deliverables, providing regular status updates and supporting the resolution of risks, issues, and dependencies;
  • Support operational design development by consolidating raw data into compliant base drawings and ensuring consistent coding and naming conventions for effective tracking and change management.
  • Monitor stadium readiness, including maintenance activities, infrastructure upgrades, and rehabilitation projects, identifying gaps, risks, and dependencies that may impact tournament delivery and supporting the implementation of mitigation measures.
  • Coordination and interaction with the Service Provider FAs (TEC, EGN, LOG, SGN, and others).
  • Coordinate the Handover and Handback processes, including the preparation of Damage Reports;

Education 
  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
Qualification
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure;
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills;
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions;
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.) ;
  • Availability to travel if necessary.
Experience
  • Strong experience in the production and delivery of large-scale events;
  • Proven track record of managing complex and high-value projects across tier-one organizations.
Skills & Competencies
  • Excellent teamwork and leadership skills 
  • Excellent written, verbal, and active listening communication skills 
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills 
  • Conflict resolution skills are a must. 
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority. 
  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • High sense of accountability, trustworthiness, and ethics. 
  • Customer and results oriented. 
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Right to live and work in Brazil 
  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods 
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.

job.title: Commercial Legal Admin Assistant
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
FIFA’s Commercial Legal team, which deals with all FIFA’s business-related legal matters, including partnerships, licensing, intellectual property, music, digital and technology, is looking for a clerk to join us in our Coral Gables, Miami offices.

The role will be a supporting function within the Legal and Compliance administrative team, which assists in the delivery of legal services relating to the development of football at every level, from grassroots initiatives, to elite international competitions.

This is an entry level position with an opportunity to support with administrative, as well as, operational functions of the office – which has a “team first” approach.

In particular, the Legal Clerk will act as a team assistant and will:
  • Deliver support to a very active and growing team and Director
  • Assist with day-to-day administrative activities such as calendar management, meeting scheduling, coordination of travel, and expense requests
  • Assist with day-to-day operational functions such as organizing and coordinating events, trainings, programs and meetings with domestic and international visitors, participants and associations
  • Support in preparing legal correspondence, power point presentations and templates, trackers and reports
  • Assist in special projects, as needed
  • Assist in supporting the Team’s strategic priorities and development activities
  • Assist with ensuring FIFA internal processes are adhered to, and complied with, from an administrative perspective
  • Complete assigned projects and tasks within given deadlines despite competing priorities
  • Assist the lead administrative team of the Legal and Compliance Division as a dedicated, supportive and helpful team member
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

This role would suit someone with some experience of working in an office environment, who is enthusiastic to learn and be part of a busy team, with great organizational and communication skills.

In particular, the Team Assistant should have:
  • A “team first” approach and be a key contributor to this strategic priority
  • First class written and spoken English language skills
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective, as well as, solutions oriented
  • Able to set priorities, keep deadlines and achieve organizational goals
  • Enjoy interaction and coordinating with other internal and external stakeholders
  • Enjoy working in a team of busy professionals
  • Understanding of contracts management and rights management for a legal department
  • Structured, reliable, well-organised with a strong eye for detail
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility with an ability to work autonomously
  • Resilient with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent
    communication skills
  • High degree of professionalism and confident demeanour
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during contract execution, external clients
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone
  • College or Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum of 2 years administrative assistant experience or previous legal office experience
  • Native level English (or equivalent)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish) is an asset but not required
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office products, including Word / PowerPoint / Excel
  • Proficient in creating presentations
  • Readiness for stand-by duties and special projects
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.

job.title: Senior Licensing & Development Manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
The Senior Licensing & Development Manager is part of the Licensing & Retail (L&R) team which is responsible for setting the strategy, objectives and deliverables of event and 365 licensing & retail programs to deliver against budget, meet fan demands and stakeholder expectations. 
In addition, a key objective is to improve the collaboration and integration of licensing & retail needs and opportunities in the wider commercial partners and media strategy and teams. 

These are your key tasks:
  • Responsible for the identification, negotiation and management of all official licensing contracts and licensees (relating to both event and 365 licensed & retail business) both mono-branded and branded.
  • Work collaboratively and pro-actively with the relevant stakeholders to establish the relevant licensing program needed to meet fan demands.
  • Build strong professional relationships with other teams and functional areas to drive the understanding, integration and opportunity of L&R.
  • Pro-active contribution to the overall business strategy, provide strategic input and business knowledge and insights.
  • Management of licensees’ contracts and other appointed relevant providers as aligned with the senior management team.
  • Work with data and insights teams to inform the licensed business and, where possible and required, contribute to the delivery of key data to drive future business and overall insights for the commercial P&M division.
  • Support in the sales and royalty reporting processes and systems working closely with the senior management team and particularly the team lead retail & planning.
  • Together with the L&R team plan and work with the official licensees to drive product, promotion and distribution strategies for wholesale and FIFA d2c retail.
  • Together with the senior L&R management team drive an integrative approach and work streams with the MBBI team in relation to developing and optimising marketing opportunities with branded licensees.
  • Together with the senior L&R management team develop the brand strategy, product category and product segmentation to deliver wholesale and D2C retail business.
  • Identify new licensed products business streams in digital, phygital and other innovative business opportunities and work with applicable teams to develop such products.
  • Develop FIFA licensed business across all relevant and applicable territories.
  • Identify and share market trends and customer needs to translate them into strategic actions to drive and build FIFA IP equity, brand, retail & product exposure to ultimately drive and grow revenue.
  • Develop best in class key licensee management in aligned with senior L&R management team. 
  • Any other related L&R matters as assigned by Head of Licensing & Retail.
  • Together with the senior L&R management team pro-actively manage documents, boiler plates, systems and documentation processes deliver against legal, governance, import/export, compliance and sustainability needs and provisions, working closely with the relevant teams (e.g legal, compliance, tax, logistics).
  • Build a strong relationship with the commercial partnerships team to identify, drive and manage licensed business opportunities with commercial partners current and future. 
    Pro-actively contribute to workflow processes and systems to drive efficiencies and effectiveness. 
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • At least 8 years’ experience and relevant background in licensing, account management, or other relevant position working for an agency, rights holder or licensee. Proven ability to implement, analyse and improve processes, measure results, and achieve financial goals
  • Experience in the sports and/or commercial sector is a must 
  • Understanding of the interaction of product, retail and marketing
  • Knowledge of legal and financial matters in relation to the licensed business
  • Relevant business degree 
  • Fluent in English, both verbal and written form
  • Proficiency in any other language is an asset
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel
  • Technology and innovation savvy
  • Experience working with contract management system
  • Excellent understanding of GTM and product development processes and timelines
  • Strong understanding of financial statements and the financial and legal aspects of licensing
  • Strong stakeholder (internal & external) management skills 
  • Excellent time management and organisational skills 
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Energetic, positive and with a can-do attitude
  • Team player 
  • Willingness to travel on a frequent basis
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Warehouse & Distribution Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
This role will be responsible for delivering Warehouse Logistics operations to support a number of stadiums/venues, ensuring a seamless and efficient delivery of services throughout the tournament.  Further, this role will assist in overseeing a team responsible for Warehouse Logistics operations, under the guidance of the Head of Logistics and Senior Manager, Warehouse. 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Act as a key Logistics representative for FIFA functions and external stakeholders for Warehouse Logistics operations across Brazil. 
  • Manage the Warehouse strategy across Brazil to align with Logistics service levels and ensure cost effective storage solution for FWWC2027. 
  • Manage the overall planning, implementation, operational process across all Warehouse Logistics operations to achieve a seamless supply chain solution 
  • Manage the Warehouse Logistics Team including overseeing health and well-being, effective motivation, setting project goals, training, coordinating work assignments and evaluating performance 
  • Assist in producing standard operating procedures, workflow charts and communication strategies for the Warehouse(s) 
  • Foster internal relationships within Logistics and FIFA to conduct space requirements and volume metric exercises on incoming / outgoing FFE, equipment and other commodities
  • Help achieve departmental financial objectives by participating, planning, and preparing various cost analysis documents; feasibility studies, budget tracking and reconciliation reports; scheduling expenditures; analyzing variances; initiating corrective actions while working towards the elimination of product loss and shrinkage 
  • Produce reports and statistics regularly (in/out status report, dead stock report etc.) 
  • Work with Material Logistics to develop and manage the FF&E procurement schedule, ensuring that adequate Warehouse space is scoped and available  
  • In collaboration with the Venue Logistics, Materials and Distribution work streams, coordinate all move orders (from warehouses to venues, venue-to-venue and venue to warehouse). Remain in constant communication with Venue Logistics to ensure the needs of the venue and functional areas are being met in a timely manner 
  • In conjunction with the LSP, conduct safety audits on multi-leveled warehouse activities and verify the daily implementation of safety related procedures are communicated and followed 
  • Assist in quantifying Material Handling Equipment (MHE) needs for the warehouse, develop necessary training programs and oversee the planned MHE maintenance schedule 
  • Help establish perimeter security protocols for the Warehouse(s) 
  • Communicate delivery “volume / pallet / vehicle standards” across Logistics function 
  • Assist in the management of receipt, storage, distribution, resupply, and recovery of FWWC2027 assets and equipment at the Warehouse(s)  
  • Liaise with Procurement and / or Finance on the payment of commodity Purchase Orders
  • Participate in the Logistics Coordination Center ensuring high level of support for Warehouse processes during tournament time 
  • Help enforce the Warehouse Logistics budget, in accordance with the Head of Logistics
  • Actively participate in developing strategic plans to fulfil FWWC2027 sustainability commitments and goals
  • Participate in outreach programs, as required, intended to educate stakeholders on tournament time operations
  • Strong experience in Warehousing, Major Event Logistics, planning and delivery phases etc.
  • Team player with a strong customer-service focus, comfortable in both upward/downward communication and a desire to go the extra mile.
  • Ability to present and clearly communicate to audiences in a multitude of public/private settings as required 
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, multi-tasking, and prioritization of tasks and deliverables
  • Willing to work to complex, tight, immovable timelines while maintaining a positive attitude, exhibiting patience, persistence and experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-national environment 
  • Excellent analytical skills, ability to make decisions both independently and within a team environment 
  • Experienced in inventory management 
  • Extremely high attention to detail
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Remain in constant communication with Venue Logistics to ensure the needs of the venue and functional areas are being met in a timely manner - In conjunction with the LSP, conduct safety audits on multi-leveled warehouse activities and verify the daily implementation of safety related procedures are communicated and followed - Assist in quantifying Material Handling Equipment (MHE) needs for the warehouse, develop necessary training programs and oversee the planned MHE maintenance schedule - Help establish perimeter security protocols for the Warehouse(s) - Communicate delivery “volume / pallet / vehicle standards” across Logistics function - Assist in the management of receipt, storage, distribution, resupply, and recovery of FWWC2027 assets and equipment at the Warehouse(s) - Liaise with Procurement and / or Finance on the payment of commodity Purchase Orders - Participate in the Logistics Coordination Center ensuring high level of support for Warehouse processes during tournament time - Help enforce the Warehouse Logistics budget, in accordance with the Head of Logistics - Actively participate in developing strategic plans to fulfil FWWC2027 sustainability commitments and goals - Participate in outreach programs, as required, intended to educate stakeholders on tournament time operations
- Strong experience in Warehousing, Major Event Logistics, planning and delivery phases etc. - Team player with a strong customer-service focus, comfortable in both upward/downward communication and a desire to go the extra mile. - Ability to present and clearly communicate to audiences in a multitude of public/private settings as required - Proven track record in managing complex projects, multi-tasking, and prioritization of tasks and deliverables - Willing to work to complex, tight, immovable timelines while maintaining a positive attitude, exhibiting patience, persistence and experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-national environment - Excellent analytical skills, ability to make decisions both independently and within a team environment - Experienced in inventory management - Extremely high attention to detail - Right to work in Brazil. - Fluent in English (spoken and written) - Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) - Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Host City Venue Transport Manager - 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. 

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
TThe Host City Venue Transport Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering all stadium transport operations for and during the tournament. This role ensures seamless, safe, and efficient transportation services for all FIFA client groups and spectators, guaranteeing operational readiness and flawless delivery on match days and non-match days. The position also liaises closely with the Host City and relevant transport and security authorities to support the development of the Host City Mobility Plan and to ensure the effective design and delivery of the stadium and other venue’s surrounding transport and traffic plans.

This role reports to the Venue Transport Manager (HQ).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Act as the primary liaison between the Transport FA and Host City and relevant transport and security authorities for the Host City stadium and other venue’s transport planning and operational matters.
  • Act as the central coordinator for the development of Host City stadium and other venue’s Policies & Procedures, reports, presentations and Guidelines.
  • Work closely with existing Stadium teams to coordinate FIFA Constituent Group transport provisions and access to/from stadium as well as with City authorities such as Traffic Management, Police, City integrated control Centre.
  • Implement and enforce VAPP, vehicle check points, parking and load zone procedures, emergency plans, and contingency transport measures. Ensure accessible parking and transport solutions for clients with reduced mobility.
  • Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees relating to Host City stadium Operations such as Parking and Traffic attendants. 
  • Ensures Host City stadium and other venue’s transport staff are properly trained by developing and maintaining training materials and coordinating the delivery of operational workshops and briefings, and role-specific instructions. 
  • It’s also responsible, in coordination with the Traffic and Parking Operator, for developing and delivering the full training program for all operational team, including designing training content, defining formats (classroom, online, practical sessions), and establishing clear timelines and schedules. This includes supporting planning of how and when training will be delivered, determining training duration and required number of days, organizing group sessions to cover the entire stadium transport workforce, and ensuring consistent standards and materials. 
  • Provide regular reporting to HQ, FIFA counterparts, and other key stakeholders on coordination progress, issues, and decisions.
  • Ensure VVIP, VIP, delegations, referees, media, and workforce movements, at stadium and other venues, are executed according to plan/service levels.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with other event areas (Security, Guest Operations, Venue Operations, TSV, etc.) to ensure coherent and efficient engagement with stadium and other venue’s transport matters.
  • Use Fleet Management System (TMM) to input key FIFA client group stadium access route, drop-off and load zone.
  • Support test events, rehearsals, and operational readiness exercises. Oversee the installation and readiness of signage, operational equipment, radios, barriers, and wayfinding.
  • Deliver operational briefings and ensure all staff understand daily priorities, procedures, schedules, roles, and safety requirements.
  • Maintain constant live communication with the Transport Command and Control, providing real-time updates on stadium and other venue’s operations, incidents, delays, and any emerging issues. Ensure that all critical issue is escalated promptly, enabling rapid decision-making and coordinated responses across all transport functions and the Host City. This includes monitoring on-ground conditions, reporting deviations from the plan, and implementing solutions to ensure smooth and uninterrupted service delivery.
Qualifications:
  • Education – Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/Civil Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset.
Experience:
  • Relevant experience in Event transport or experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time critical project.
  • Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Experience working with public and private sector partners in a collaborative environment and ability to build strong partnerships.
Skills:
  • Advanced knowledge of administration and management principles.
  • Advanced knowledge of teams’ leadership, business process management. 
  • Advanced communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, the ability to influence others and manage relationships.
  • Ability to design, implement and operate a transport system in the Brazilian event environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of transportation technical operating processes and activities.
  • Ability to motivate others toward a common goal and manage a multidisciplinary team through conflicting priorities and continuous change requests.
  • Ability to work and communicate in a corporate and project focused organisation.  
  • Proven project management skills within a complex project.
  • Strong analytical and organisation skills.
  • Proven solution orientated decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure to immoveable deadlines.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Network Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Network Manager (NWM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. The NWM will work closely with the FIFA Technology teams and the Stadia Teams, as well as other stakeholders. The NWM will understand the stadia legacy network ensuring it will support FIFA’s needs during the FWWC 2027. The NWM will also manage the integration between FIFA’s Game’s Time network and the legacy network.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Manage the planning, delivery, and operations of network infrastructure for FIFA and Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) offices, FIFA Special Events, and the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Review and validate Network Infrastructure designs, ensuring all deliverables—hardware, passive infrastructure, cybersecurity, monitoring, alerting, etc.—are implemented according to FIFA standards across venues and offices.
  • Actively participate in scope definition, procurement processes, supplier selection, and onboarding of Telco and Network service providers.
  • Lead the deployment and implementation of network infrastructure, securing timely availability of components and services, including the commissioning and decommissioning of event venues.
  • Oversee the effective and efficient delivery of Network services for FIFA offices, tournaments, and selected FIFA events. Monitor progress, report status, identify risks, and ensure alignment with IT governance.
  • Perform equipment configuration, testing, handover, monitoring, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Support network-related projects by clarifying requirements, following robust change management procedures, and ensuring clear communication across stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and coaching to team members, including preparing best-practice materials and training resources
  • Create and/or manage KPIs dashboards for operating stadia networks (FIFA’s and legacy) for the Telecom Command Center (TCC)
Education
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field
Experience
  • Minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred
  • Proven experience of successful delivery of complex network infrastructure projects
Skills & Competencies
  • Strong technical expertise in telecom service provider networks, wired/wireless infrastructure design and deployment, network integration, and connectivity.
  • Proven experience with WAN/LAN, MPLS, VPN, routing and switching technologies, and multicast operations.
  • Relevant technical certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, CISSP) or equivalent professional experience.
  • Solid understanding of structured cabling (copper and fiber) in heterogeneous environments.
  • Excellent consulting, negotiation, communication, and facilitation skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to train and present to diverse audiences.
  • Team‑oriented mindset with the ability to work under tight deadlines.
  • Demonstrates patience, persistence, and a positive attitude.
  • Experience delivering wireless networks in complex, high‑density environments.
  • Grafana, PowerBI and other BI related tools for creating dashboards or collecting data.
Certifications & Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portugues
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
Various
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more)

job.title: Training & Readiness Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Manager, Training & Readiness (Safety & Security) is responsible for designing, implementing and overseeing the tournament-wide capability-building, training and readiness programme for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role ensures that all safety and security personnel — including direct hires and supplier staff — meet defined competence, licensing and readiness standards prior to deployment.

The position establishes structured training frameworks, certification processes and exercise programmes to ensure operational preparedness across stadiums and non-competition sites. The role supports the creation of a sustainable safety and security legacy in Brazil through structured upskilling and professionalisation of the workforce.

• Conduct a comprehensive market capability and capacity analysis to identify gaps and risks related to the provision of staffed safety and security services
• Identify applicable qualification, certification and licensing criteria within Brazil and its federal states relevant to guarding, stewarding, close protection and related disciplines
• Design and implement a bespoke capability-building strategy for internal staff and external security suppliers
• Design and deliver security training programmes tailored to specific roles (e.g. security guards, stewards, supervisors, managers, TSLOs/RSLOs and direct hires)
• Develop and implement a structured training curriculum and training materials aligned with the Safety & Security Strategy and Operational Plan
• Design, develop and implement analogue and digital training solutions, including instructor-led programmes, workshops and e-learning packages, ensuring scalable, accessible and role-specific learning delivery across all safety and security personnel
• Define readiness criteria and certification processes for safety and security personnel prior to deployment
• Establish systems to track workforce competence, training completion and deployment readiness across all official tournament sites
• Coordinate and oversee joint exercises, table-top simulations, venue rehearsals and scenario-based drills to test operational response and inter-agency coordination
• Design and implement programmes to ensure compliance with statutory qualification and licensing standards on site, including the development of quality control audit processes
• Engage with safety and security suppliers to ensure that capability-building programmes are delivered effectively and that all personnel are trained before commencing work
• Coordinate with other FWWC2027 functional areas to ensure alignment on policies, procedures and response protocols
• Oversee the delivery and evaluation of drills, simulations and readiness exercises to ensure operational effectiveness
• Identify training gaps and implement corrective actions through continuous improvement processes
• Conduct on-site quality control audits to verify training completion, certification and operational competence
• Support senior management and site management in verifying training-related supplier invoices and compliance documentation

Education
• University degree in security management, education and training, public safety, risk management or a related field
• Professional training qualification or certification (e.g. instructional design, adult learning, security training accreditation) is desirable

Experience
• Experience in safety and security training, workforce readiness or operational preparedness roles
• Demonstrated experience designing and delivering structured training programmes in large-scale operational environments
• Experience coordinating exercises, simulations and multi-agency readiness activities
• Familiarity with Brazilian licensing and qualification requirements in the security sector
• Experience working with public security authorities and private security suppliers

Skills & Competencies
• Strong instructional design and training delivery capability
• Structured and analytical approach to readiness measurement and workforce tracking
• Excellent organisational and project management skills
• Ability to coordinate complex multi-stakeholder exercises and rehearsals
• Strong leadership and stakeholder engagement capability
• Clear written and verbal communication skills
• Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word

Certifications & Requirements:
• Right to work in Brazil. 
• Fluent in English (spoken and written)
• Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
• Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: F&B Concessions Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
FIFA has setup a fully owned Local Entity to deliver the ninth edition of the FIFA Women’s World Cup™, held in Brazil. The success and the growth of the competition depend on the ability and capabilities of the FIFA team to provide an enhanced experienced to all the key stakeholders linked to the tournament: fans and spectators following the event, participating teams and FIFA Commercial Partners.   

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Senior F&B Concessions Manager, the F&B Concessions Manager is responsible for managing the operational planning and delivery readiness of the Public Food & Beverage (F&B) Concessions Programme across all official tournament stadiums. The objective is to implement and deliver successfully the FIFA Commercial Partners’ exclusive food & beverage rights.

The role is responsible for overseeing concessionaire operational planning, coordinating tournament deliverables, ensuring compliance with FIFA requirements, and supporting venue readiness activities. The F&B Concessions Manager acts as the primary operational interface between FIFA, appointed concessionaires, stadium authorities, and Host Football Associations (FAs) to ensure all operational requirements are planned, documented, and delivered according to FIFA timelines and standards.

The role does not hold responsibility for commercial negotiations, contractual management, menu approval, pricing strategy, Commercial Partner relationship management, or defining commercial rights delivery strategy, which remain under the responsibility of the Senior F&B Concessions Manager and FIFA Partnership Rights Delivery team.

Key responsibilities
  • Manage appointed F&B Concessionaire(s) throughout the planning and delivery phases, monitoring compliance with FIFA requirements, project timelines and agreed operational deliverables;
  • Manage the planning and implementation of the Public Food & Beverage Concessions Programme across all official tournament stadiums, ensuring operational readiness, consistency of delivery and compliance with FIFA requirements;
  • Manage the operational implementation of the commercial rights granted to FIFA’s Commercial Partners within the F&B Concessions Programme, ensuring approved products, services and activation requirements are successfully integrated into stadium operations;
  • Establish, implement and maintain operational procedures, controls, checklists and reporting mechanisms to support the successful delivery of the F&B Concessions Programme;
  • Review, track and manage concessionaire deliverables, operational plans and readiness submissions, ensuring all requirements are delivered in accordance with FIFA standards and tournament deadlines;
  • Coordinate the development and implementation of operational plans covering staffing, logistics, inventory management, food safety, sustainability, service delivery and contingency planning across all official stadiums;
  • Develop and deliver training programmes, operational briefings and implementation guidelines for concessionaires, service providers and venue-based F&B resources;
  • Oversee the review, mapping and optimization of F&B infrastructure, facilities and operational layouts within stadiums to support efficient service delivery and compliance with tournament requirements;
  • Support the F&B Concessions team in the preparation and coordination of planning activities with FIFA Partnership Rights Delivery (Zurich) and other relevant FIFA functional areas to ensure alignment of operational and commercial objectives;
  • Supervise the development and delivery of stadium F&B operations by appointed concessionaire(s), ensuring approved Commercial Partner requirements are implemented and stakeholder expectations are achieved;
  • Manage operational relationships with appointed F&B Concessionaire(s), FIFA functional areas and venue stakeholders, ensuring effective communication, coordination and information flow throughout all tournament phases;
  • Coordinate the reviewing and implementation of F&B operational signage elements, including menu boards and other concession-related branding and information materials, in collaboration with FIFA Partnership Rights Delivery and appointed concessionaires;
  • Monitor stadium infrastructure and operational readiness delivery against established requirements, producing regular status reports, risk assessments and mitigation plans;
  • Manage and coordinate the team of F&B Venue Managers, providing leadership, guidance and operational support across all official tournament venues;
  • Support FIFA and FIFA27 Headquarters throughout tournament operations by consolidating venue reporting, monitoring operational performance, coordinating issue resolution and ensuring consistent implementation of FIFA standards across all stadiums;
  • Oversee daily public F&B concession operations during the tournament, supporting the resolution of operational challenges and ensuring service levels and spectator experience objectives are achieved;
  • Coordinate testing events, operational rehearsals and readiness exercises to validate concessionaire preparedness and support successful tournament delivery;
  • Produce operational reports, readiness updates, post-event evaluations and lessons learned documentation to support decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives;
  • Establish reporting procedures and communication protocols between venue-based F&B teams and FIFA27 Headquarters to ensure consistent implementation of operational standards across all venues.
  • Minimum 4 years’ experience in the food and beverage, catering, or related professional area;
  • Proven successful management and delivery of F&B concessions projects at major international and high-profile events, preferably in the sports industry;
  • Advanced knowledge of the food & beverage concessions industry and preferably at football stadiums; 
  • Experience in major international sports / large-scale event management; 
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, including overlay, preferably in the sports industry;
  • Experience in project infrastructure management;
