job.title: Commercial Matchday Hosts
job.html_description:
Job Title: Commercial Matchday Hosts

Responsible to: Head of Commercial

Apply here: https://forms.office.com/e/12c4GXBGmg

About The Role:

As a host at Elland Road, you will be the first point of contact for many of our VIP hospitality guests. In this role you would be required to act as the face of the Club within your allocated hospitality lounge, creating a seamless link between our hospitality department, our catering department and our VIP matchday guests. This will ensure that our guests receive the highest possible standard of service and have an exceptional hospitality experience.

Allocation Main Responsibilities

  • Positions are offered for matchdays only, with a typical shift lasting approximately seven to eight hours.

  • Attending pre-match hospitality host / hostess briefing prior to each shift;

  • Familiarise yourself with your designated suite (which may change each shift), checking the suite and other guests facilities meet required standards and ensuring corporate lanyards and programmes are set out as per the guests chosen package;

  • Welcoming all guests into your suite, building relationships by using eye contact and escorting guests to their assigned dining area / table;

  • Build relationships with customers pre-match, at half time and full time.

  • Continuously managing the flow of guests in to the suite ensuring all

    guests catering needs are being met and all guests are happy;

  • Be particularly attentive to new guests to ensure they are comfortable in their surroundings whilst being observant towards and engaging with all guests at all times to ensure the highest levels of service throughout the day;

  • Resolving any issues as they arise to ensure the guests' matchday experience is not effected, raising to the next level and / or appropriate departments as required (usually Duty Manager in your allocated lounge)

  • Directing guests to the appropriate match seats;

  • Answering any questions hospitality guests may have about other events

    and fixtures;

  • Report any faults with facilities and any catering issues without delay;

  • Any other reasonable duties

Required Technical Skills

  • Previous experience as a host or hostess, or hospitality waiter or waitress in a hospitality environment, or front of house experience, is preferred.

Required Behavioural Attitudes

  • Strong interpersonal skills

  • Candidates must be well presented, mature, professional and have an outgoing personality

  • The ability to work efficiently in a high pressured and dynamic sporting environment

  • A good approach to teamwork and ability to manage a busy hospitality area

  • Ability to troubleshoot under pressure

  • Excellent customer service skills and spoken English required

  • Ability to use initiative and be creative

  • Strong customer service skills

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Ability to prioritise case load and manage time effectively

  • Confident and assertive

  • Ambition, passion and willingness to learn

job.title: Development Chef
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a talented and creative Development Chef to join our Liverpool FC team.

This is your chance to bring your culinary creativity to life in a fast-paced and innovative environment where great food, fresh thinking and new ideas are at the heart of what we do.

Working from our Central Production Kitchen, you’ll take inspiration from the latest food trends, experiment with new concepts and help develop exciting products from idea through to kitchen. You’ll collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, sharing your expertise and passion while helping shape our evolving food offering.

You’ll also join a supportive and collaborative team where development is encouraged, with opportunities to learn, upskill and broaden your culinary experience.

What will you be doing?

  • Develop innovative menu ideas, food concepts and product ranges.
  • Research culinary trends and translate insights into new ideas for menus and products.
  • Present findings, run tastings and deliver product showcases for key stakeholders.
  • Create new and exclusive food concepts that support the club’s wider catering offer.
  • Write clear, consistent recipes that can be followed across relevant teams and food categories.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including the Executive Head Chef and Retail Catering team.
  • Ensure that products align with club goals, customer expectations and operational requirements.
  • Support menu development for matchdays, day-to-day catering and retail food products.
  • Comply with all uniform standards as required by legislation and Liverpool FC.
  • Support the recruitment of the kitchen brigade, including full-time and casual colleagues, in line with company and statutory standards.
  • Carry out annual performance reviews with direct reports, ensuring objectives are clear and well defined.
  • Work closely with the hospitality, tourism and events teams to support the delivery of an excellent customer experience.
  • Inspire and motivate the kitchen brigade to deliver high-quality food in line with specifications, while supporting budgeted sales and profit targets.
  • Attend departmental meetings as required and contribute positively as part of the management team.
  • Regularly review the quality and pricing of food suppliers to build strong partnerships and ensure the right products are in place. Suppliers should be audited before appointment and annually thereafter.
  • Meet prospective and existing clients attending events to support the sales process and build effective relationships.

Who are we looking for?

  • Proven current experience as a professional chef, within a busy, multi-site stadium or sports environment.
  • Ability to create and deliver high-quality, innovative recipes across a range of food categories.
  • Strong knowledge of culinary techniques, flavour profiles, ingredients and food trends, with the ability to turn insights into creative food concepts and menus.
  • Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, to create engaging presentations that inspire stakeholders and communicate new product development ideas.
  • Excellent organisation, communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and build positive relationships with managers, supervisors, colleagues and customers.
  • Able to work efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment, manage time well, work under pressure and use your own initiative when required.
  • High standards of hygiene, presentation and professionalism, with sound recipe-writing practices.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of current food safety legislation, including allergen requirements and Natasha’s Law.
  • Creative approach to problem-solving, with the ability to innovate and stay up to date with changes across the food industry.
  • Ability to plan and lead small events, with flexibility to work occasional evenings when required.

Desirable experience and skills:

  • Experience in a similar role within a football stadium or sports venue.
  • Experience working in a front-of-house environment.
  • Ability to work to strict deadlines in a pressured environment.
  • Budget-writing experience.
  • Ability to speak an additional language.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time, permanent role working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our Anfield Stadium. 

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment. This role is subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS check.

job.title: Casual Goalkeeping Coach, LFC Foundation
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our LFC Foundation team as a Casual Goalkeeping Coach. In this role you will support and develop all players within the group to attain the highest levels of performance in a safe, secure, and supportive environment and drive and nurture a positive culture within the training group. Be a coach who makes the Football Development Programme a place where players learn, have fun, and develop a love for the game.

What will you be doing?

  • Contribute to the LFC Foundation Delivery Blueprint / Curriculum ensuring there is Goalkeeping provision which complements the football programme.  
  • Deliver – or oversee the delivery of – Girls Goalkeeping Centre and Football Development programme, including:
  • Design and deliver individualised Goalkeeping specific programmes as well as group training sessions 
  • Work with Physiotherapist/Sports Therapist to develop and support an activation / prehab programme
  • Manage facilities and equipment within the Girls Pathway and Football Development Programme so that it is well maintained and safe to use
  • Maintain a comprehensive database of work conducted with players and coaches.  Keep records which meet the standard required by The FA and the appropriate professional bodies
  • Communicate with parents in the event of Goalkeeping related queries, generally and specifically to their children. Educate parents with regard to their role in supporting Goalkeeping development, injury prevention, injury care, recovery, diet and other factors relating to lifestyle away from the environment. 
  • Advise and direct other staff on the needs of players.   Attend case management meetings and provide professional opinion /input
  • Educate coaches on the Goalkeeping provision and embedding outcomes within technical sessions
  • Work with the LFC Foundations Safeguarding Manager to ensure that the wellbeing and welfare of all players and staff is always an operational priority

Who are we looking for?

Essential:

  • Experience working with young athletes in a football environment.
  • A good understanding of young players, including their physical and psychological development.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of child protection and safeguarding procedures.
  • Experience in a role that supports an understanding of how children learn and develop, such as teaching or coaching.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and public holidays.
  • Ability to adapt to changing situations and support players in a positive way.
  • A genuine care for player needs, with the ability to provide personalised support and clear communication.
  • An innovative and open-minded approach, with confidence to try new ideas that help players develop, engage and enjoy the game.
  • National Goalkeeping Course and FA UEFA C qualification.
  • FA DBS, FA Safeguarding Children, and FA Level 1 Introduction to First Aid in Football or FA Emergency Aid qualification.
  • Understanding of goalkeeping within an applied team setting, with knowledge of how key goalkeeping concepts apply across women’s, girls’ and boys’ football pathways.
  • Experience developing and delivering individual and group goalkeeping preparation and recovery strategies for children and adolescent players.
  • Knowledge of injury minimisation strategies.

Desirable:

  • Working towards, or already completed, UEFA B Goalkeeping or Outfield qualification would be beneficial.
  • Talent identification and development knowledge, including awareness of unconscious bias, performance and potential.
  • Commitment to continued professional development.
  • A coaching or mentoring qualification, such as EMCC, would be desirable.

Why should you apply?

This is a casual position, working variable hours across the week including evening, weekends and public holidays on a flexible assignment basis. The role is based at the LFC Academy and local sites across Merseyside for fixtures.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

job.title: Senior Sales Advisor, Chester Store
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our Liverpool FC team as a Senior Sales advisor. In this role you will work closely with our store management team, in order to drive the store team to ensure excellent customer service and store performance.  

What will you be doing?  

  • Understanding store targets and KPIs to ensure that targets are delivered. 
  • Taking responsibility for running departments within the store and ensuring that all targets are met, and high standards are maintained at all times.
  • Managing the shopfloor, including queues, customer issues, stock availability issues and printing issues, to ensure that high standards are delivered and maintained. 
  • Ensuring all deliveries are received and processed in most efficient manner and the shopfloor is commercially merchandised. 
  • Undertaking keyholder responsibilities, which will include holding the store in the absence of the Store Manager, Assistant Manager & Store Supervisor.  
  • Opening and closing the store, carrying out till counts, investigating, resolving, actioning or escalating any till losses or discrepancies, cashing up, safe counts, banking and managing collections, to complete all of this in accordance with Store standards and compliance checks. 
  • Reviewing the daily handover documents and daily planner to allocate daily activities to the store team, using this detail to talk through the daily brief with the team, providing key targets for the day and allocating sections and/or jobs to the store team. Reviewing that activities are being actioned and follow up as necessary. 
  • Completing customer service observations and floor walks to ensure we maintain high store standards and direct the team to implement any actions. 
  • Supporting with shopfloor moves and any promotional activities and product launches, for example Kit launch and taking responsibility for any key actions in preparation for key launches/events. 
  • Supporting the management team in delivering refresher training to the existing store team, whilst supporting the induction and training of new store team members. 
  • Undertaking all tasks in accordance with our retail standards and to participate in regular meetings and training.

Who are we looking for? 

To be successful you will have leadership experience working in a retail store environment and have the ability to motivate and drive a team. You will also have strong product awareness and understanding of good customer experience. Including worked in a customer facing setting, where you have developed excellent customer service skills.    

You will have excellent numerical and analytical skills and be able to solve problems quickly and effectively. You`ll have an eye for detail and be confident working in a fast paced environment, working as part of a team and independently, with the ability to make operational decisions.   

Why should you apply?  

This is a full-time permanent role working 16hours per week. Your main base will be our Chester Store. 

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

- Understanding store targets and KPIs to ensure that targets are delivered. - Taking responsibility for running departments within the store and ensuring that all targets are met, and high standards are maintained at all times. - Managing the shopfloor, including queues, customer issues, stock availability issues and printing issues, to ensure that high standards are delivered and maintained. - Ensuring all deliveries are received and processed in most efficient manner and the shopfloor is commercially merchandised. - Undertaking keyholder responsibilities, which will include holding the store in the absence of the Store Manager, Assistant Manager & Store Supervisor. - Opening and closing the store, carrying out till counts, investigating, resolving, actioning or escalating any till losses or discrepancies, cashing up, safe counts, banking and managing collections, to complete all of this in accordance with Store standards and compliance checks. - Reviewing the daily handover documents and daily planner to allocate daily activities to the store team, using this detail to talk through the daily brief with the team, providing key targets for the day and allocating sections and/or jobs to the store team. Reviewing that activities are being actioned and follow up as necessary. - Completing customer service observations and floor walks to ensure we maintain high store standards and direct the team to implement any actions. - Supporting with shopfloor moves and any promotional activities and product launches, for example Kit launch and taking responsibility for any key actions in preparation for key launches/events. - Supporting the management team in delivering refresher training to the existing store team, whilst supporting the induction and training of new store team members. - Undertaking all tasks in accordance with our retail standards and to participate in regular meetings and training.
Who are we looking for?
To be successful you will have leadership experience working in a retail store environment and have the ability to motivate and drive a team. You will also have strong product awareness and understanding of good customer experience. Including worked in a customer facing setting, where you have developed excellent customer service skills.
You will have excellent numerical and analytical skills and be able to solve problems quickly and effectively. You`ll have an eye for detail and be confident working in a fast paced environment, working as part of a team and independently, with the ability to make operational decisions.
Why should you apply?
This is a full-time permanent role working 16hours per week. Your main base will be our Chester Store.
Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:
- Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5% - Life Assurance Cover - Free financial guidance and mortgage advice - Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving - Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active - Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting - Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers - Will Writing Service for future planning - Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support - Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs - Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community - Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

job.title: SMF Relationship Manager (LFC Foundation)
job.location: Anfield Sports & Community Centre, United Kingdom
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our LFC Foundation team as a SMF Relationship Manager. 

You will lead the day to day management of one of Liverpool FC Foundation’s largest partnerships, the Steve Morgan Foundation (SMF). This will include the delivery and continued growth of our Community Hubs programme and wider place-based initiatives across Anfield. 

You'll play a key role in creating lasting impact by ensuring programmes are delivered to the highest standard, driving measurable outcomes for local communities and securing long-term sustainability. Working closely with partners and stakeholders, you will oversee contractual compliance, monitor performance against agreed KPIs, and ensure SMF-funded programmes consistently deliver against ambitious plans and objectives. 

What will you be doing? 

  • Act as the day-to-day lead for the Steve Morgan Foundation relationship, working alongside senior leadership.
  • Ensure delivery aligns with funder priorities and strategic outcomes, ensuring effective monitoring and evaluation.
  • Lead and oversee the Community Hubs programme across the Liverpool City Region, building and maintaining strong relationships across the youth sector.
  • Manage the Foundation’s place-based programme in the Anfield community.
  • Oversee programme performance, contracts, KPIs and impact measurement.
  • Responsible for all reporting requirements and lead quarterly meetings and biannual reporting.
  • Develop and secure additional grants and other fundraising opportunities, driving the long-term sustainability of the programme.
  • Support place-based and system-wide development opportunities.
  • Line manager responsibility which includes working cross-departmentally to coordinate delivery.
  • Responsible for mitigating risks across the programme and ensure safeguarding and health and safety practices are maintained to the highest standard.
  • Support the leadership team to influence local, regional and national policy aligned to SMF and LFC Foundation priorities.

Who are we looking for? 

  • Experience managing high-value funder relationships, building stakeholder networks, and influencing senior partners to achieve shared outcomes.
  • Proven ability to lead complex community, youth or place-based programmes, ensuring delivery against objectives, workplans and KPIs.
  • Strong understanding of community development, place-based approaches, and the youth sector landscape across Liverpool City Region.
  • Experience designing and implementing performance frameworks, analysing data, and demonstrating social impact through robust reporting.
  • Track record of securing grant funding, developing funding proposals, and identifying opportunities to support long-term programme sustainability.
  • Experience managing and developing staff while working effectively across departments, partners and multi-agency networks.
  • Knowledge and experience of managing funded contracts, safeguarding, health and safety, governance, and programme risk.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing reports for funders and senior stakeholders and contributing to local, regional or national policy discussions 

Why should you apply? 

This is a full-time permanent role working 35 hours per week (5 in 7). Your main base will be Anfield Sports and Community Centre  

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. 

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf 

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you. 

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment. This role is subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS check.

job.title: Supervisor, London Store
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our Liverpool FC team as a Retail Store Supervisor at our brand-new London store! This is a fantastic chance to be part of something fresh and innovative, contributing directly to the ongoing growth and development of LFC Retail. 

It’s an incredible time to join the LFC family, with our standout collaborations with Adidas and Tommy Hilfiger bringing new momentum, style, and global visibility to the brand.

As a key member of the store’s management team, you’ll work closely with the Store Manager and Assistant Manager to lead, inspire, and drive the team. Your role will be essential in delivering exceptional customer service, achieving strong results, and ensuring the store consistently performs against targets and plans.

What will you be doing?

  • Understanding store targets and KPIs to ensure that targets are delivered.
  • Taking responsibility for running departments within the store and running of the store and ensuring that all targets are met, and high standards are always maintained.
  • Ensuring all deliveries are received and processed in most efficient manner and the shop floor is commercially merchandised.
  • Responsibility for running the store and day to day management of the store and store staff and responding to call outs (as appropriate).
  • Opening and closing the store, carrying out till counts, investigating, resolving, actioning, or escalating any till losses or discrepancies, cashing up, safe counts, banking and managing collections, to complete all of this in accordance with Store standards and compliance checks.
  • Reviewing the daily handover documents and daily planner to allocate daily activities to the store team, using this detail to talk through the daily brief with the team, providing key targets for the day and allocating sections and/or jobs to the store team.
  • Completing management paperwork as required, including, but not limited to reviewing store reports and using these reports to implement any action and/or decisions, ensuring all paperwork and store actions will deliver consistent results above the retail benchmark for Store Compliance Audits.
  • Completing customer service observations and floor walks to ensure we maintain high store standards and direct the team to implement any actions.
  • Supporting with shop floor moves and any promotional activities and product launches, for example Kit launch and taking responsibility for any key actions in preparation for key launches/events.
  • Supporting the management team in delivering refresher training to the existing store team, whilst supporting the induction and training of new store team members.

Who are we looking for?

To be successful in this role you must have recent experience as a supervisor in a retail store environment, including an ability to motivate and drive a team. You will have strong product awareness and an understanding of what makes a great customer experience for our customers. You will have worked in a customer facing setting, where you have developed excellent customer service skills.

You’ll be able to demonstrate excellent numerical and analytical skills and be able to solve problems quickly and effectively. You will have an eye for detail and be confident working in a fast-paced environment, working as part of a team and independently, with the ability to make operational decisions.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time permanent position working 40 hours per week on a 5 from 7 day basis. Your main base will be our new London Store.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

  • Contributory pension scheme matching up to 5.5%
  • Life Assurance Cover
  • Free financial guidance and mortgage advice
  • Car salary sacrifice scheme for affordable driving
  • Cycle to Work scheme to keep you active
  • Purchase season ticket loans for easier commuting
  • Exclusive shopping discounts & cashback with top retailers
  • Will Writing Service for future planning
  • Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support
  • Medicash Health Cash Plan for everyday healthcare needs
  • Volunteering opportunities to give back to the community
  • Special LFC perks – retail discounts, partner offers, free LFCTV GO access, and priority tickets for matches, events & concerts

…and much more! LFC Benefits.pdf

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment.

job.title: Senior Executive, Brand Solutions (NYC, US)
job.html_description:
We are looking for a Senior Executive, Brand Solutions to join the team at Liverpool FC. The Senior Executive, Brand Solutions will play a key role in supporting the development and delivery of commercial partnership proposals, helping translate brand objectives into compelling partnership opportunities.

Working closely with the Brand Solutions, Growth, and Partnership Sales team, the role will combine research, creative development, proposal creation and project coordination. The successful candidate will help ensure the team is well-informed, organised and equipped to deliver high-quality, insight-led solutions for prospective partners.

As well as supporting larger strategic proposals, the Senior Executive will take increasing ownership of individual projects and deliverables, developing their commercial understanding, creative thinking and confidence in presenting ideas.

What will you be doing?

1. Sales Materials & Proposal Development

  • Support Solutions Managers in translating brand objectives into relevant partnership propositions and compelling sales narratives.
  • Take ownership of allocated sections within larger decks, to include copy development.
  • Review and quality-check presentations to ensure accuracy, consistency, clarity and attention to detail.

2. Brand Research & Insights

  • Conduct research into prospective brands, including their history, audience, positioning, strategic priorities, recent campaigns and existing sponsorship activity.
  • Work with the Insights team to identify relevant audience data, category trends and competitor activity to inform proposal development.
  • Produce concise brand fact sheets for major briefs, highlighting key findings, strategic considerations and potential partnership opportunities.

4. Creative Development & Brainstorm Coordination

  • Work with Solutions Managers to identify opportunities for creative brainstorming and determine the appropriate team involvement.
  • Coordinate and facilitate brainstorm sessions, ensuring relevant information and briefing materials are shared in advance.
  • Capture, organise and develop initial ideas following brainstorms, sharing clear summaries and recommendations with Solutions Managers.
  • Actively contribute creative thinking and partnership ideas, building knowledge of how brands can leverage the organisation's commercial assets.
  • Maintain and develop a shared inspiration bank of relevant campaigns, partnerships and experiential activation ideas.

5. Team Operations & Project Management

  • Own and maintain the team status tracker, ensuring all live projects, responsibilities, deadlines and next steps are accurately recorded.
  • Help maintain effective team processes, improving visibility, organisation and collaboration across the Brand Solutions function.

6. Feedback, Learning & Knowledge Sharing

  • Gather feedback from Solutions Managers and the Sales team on completed proposals, identifying areas for improvement and successful approaches.
  • Capture and share learnings, examples and best practice to continuously improve the quality of future proposals.
  • Maintain organised shared folders and resources, ensuring the latest presentations, research and partnership materials are easily accessible.

Who are we looking for?

  • 3 years+ experience in a commercial, marketing, sponsorship, media, agency or brand partnerships environment.
  • Strong PowerPoint and presentation development skills, with an eye for detail and design.
  • Excellent written communication and copywriting skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to distil information into clear, relevant insights.
  • Highly organised, proactive and comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Confident communicator, able to build relationships and work effectively with different teams.
  • An interest in brands, marketing, sponsorship, sport and the wider media landscape.
  • A creative mindset, with the confidence to contribute ideas and think beyond established approaches.
  • A collaborative approach, with a willingness to take ownership and accountability.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality, accurate and compelling sales materials delivered to agreed deadlines.
  • Strong research and brand insights that provide a valuable foundation for proposal development.
  • Effective communication and alignment across multiple teams and departments.
  • A growing contribution to the creative and strategic thinking behind partnership proposals, with increasing ownership of projects and deliverables.

Why should you apply?

This is a full-time permanent position working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our office in NYC, US.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment.

job.title: Senior Specialist, Digital Graphic Design (Liverpool Football Club)
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our Liverpool FC Creative Marketing Team as a Senior Specialist, Digital Graphic Designer. You will work within the club’s marketing department and report to the Manager, Graphic Design. You will work alongside the creative marketing team to deliver the visual requirements and creative assets that support the club’s media, commercial and brand activity.

What will you be doing?

  • Create engaging, world class motion graphics, statics and animations across digital, social, web, film and campaign content, bringing fresh ideas to the team and pushing the boundaries of the brand.
  • Work in live matchday environments across men’s, women’s, academy and charitable fixtures and large-scale club announcements.
  • Optimise motion content for different platforms and formats, from social-first assets to large-scale installations, or challenging static positions.
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders, external creative support and media partners to design creative marketing inventory for go live.
  • Be able to work reactively in big moments, as well as developing high-quality, templated concepts.
  • Work within the creative marketing team to scope briefs, assist in creative problem solving, drive commercial performance through creative approach and grow brand sentiment with considered, impactful design that cuts through.
  • Communicate with stakeholders, analyse feedback and make creative decisions to ensure high performing marketing campaigns. Assist in channel tests and be able to optimise performance through creative application.

Who are we looking for?

To be successful in this role, you will have professional experience in digital graphic design, ideally within a fast-paced creative, marketing, media or brand environment. You’ll be a creative thinker with an eye for detail and a passion for motion. You will be advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator. Someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, balancing creativity with audience needs and commercial objectives. We’re looking for a team player who brings energy, positivity and fresh perspectives to every project. Due to the nature of the role, you will need to have a flexible approach to working hours across evenings and weekends.

Why should you apply? 

This is a full-time perm position working 35 hours per week. Your main base will be our city centre office in Liverpool. 

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

To reward your hard work and commitment we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus 8 bank holidays and the option to purchase up to an additional 5 days) and access to our benefits kit bag which includes but not limited to:

job.title: Christmas Retail Sales Advisors, ILAC Stores
job.location: ILAC Retail Store, Republic of Ireland
job.html_description:
We have exciting opportunity for an individual to join our Liverpool FC team as Retail Sales Advisor at our ILAC Store on a seasonal Christmas temporary contract. 

We’re looking for individuals who are passionate about customer service and enjoy working as part of a team. In this role you will be responsible for ensuring that the overall customer experience within the Liverpool Football Club Store is to the highest possible standard.

What will you be doing?

  • Dealing with customer sales and refunds, ensuring a focus on customer care and the customer experience.
  • Till work including processing cash and card payments.
  • Gaining and building upon Product knowledge to provide advice and guidance on product selection to customers.
  • Basic Sales Management through driving the AVS, UPT and Conversion by offering add on sales and upselling.
  • Merchandising/display.
  • Stock shrinkage and cash flow controls.
  • Supporting in receiving and storing the delivery of large amounts of stock.

Who are we looking for?

To be successful, you must have recent retail store and customer service experience in a customer facing role and can demonstrate this important skill set, with excellent numeracy and literacy skills. Having strong interpersonal and communication skills, you will be confident in delivering excellent customer service and working as part of a team. A retail and/or customer service qualifications would be advantageous. You will be able to work flexible hours.

Why should you apply?

This role is offering seasonal Christmas temporary contracts ending on the 27th of December, working various hours including evenings and weekends. Your main base will be our ILAC store, in Dublin

job.title: Casual Academy Physiotherapist
job.html_description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an individual to join our Liverpool FC team as a Academy Physiotherapist on a casual basis.

What will you be doing?

You will provide high-quality, player-centred physiotherapy services on a casual, ad hoc basis to players aged within the boys’ Academy pathway. Working collaboratively with the Academy Medical & Performance team and coaching staff, the role supports injury prevention, assessment, treatment and all stages of rehabilitation to promote safe participation and return to training and competition. Care will be tailored to each player’s age, stage of growth and development and individual needs, with safeguarding, welfare and long-term health central to delivery.

  • To provide cover and additional support for the Academy Medical Team when required, this will include attending training sessions and matches. 
  • To liaise with Academy coaching staff regarding players’ injury status and availability 
  • Providing pitch side emergency aid for our young players at training sessions and games both at the Academy and at various locations within the UK. 
  • Maintaining contemporaneous medical notes to exemplary standard. 
  • Ensuring high levels of professionalism and patient confidentiality. 
  • To provide treatment and rehabilitation to players within the Academy squads. 
  • To keep records which meet the standard required by The FA and the appropriate professional bodies. 
  • To ensure treatment areas are kept clean and tidy, identify any health and safety risks and pass these on to the designated team.  
  • Ensure high levels of professionalism and player confidentiality at all times. 
  • To attend and contribute to FA CPD events and further training as required. 

Who are we looking for?

Essential

  • Chartered physiotherapist and registered member of the Health Care Professions Council (HCPC) 
  • Full CSP membership which includes medical indemnity. 
  • Have an up-to-date full Advanced Emergency Aid Qualification; this should be at least the Level 4 Intermediate Trauma Medical Management in Football (ITMMIF)
  • FA Safeguarding Children Course 
  • UKAD Clean Sport Advisor  

Desirable

  • Member of Chartered Society of Physiotherapy  
  • Understanding of the Academy talent pathway 
  • Experience of working with elite club level or national level football players  
  • Engagement with professional development linked to physical development of youth players (growth and maturation, athlete physiology)

Why should you apply?

This is a casual position, offering variable hours including evenings and weekends on a flexible assignment basis.

Please note, this vacancy may close early if we receive a high volume of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

At Liverpool Football Club, we have an unwavering commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and are always looking to making a positive difference in the communities that we operate within. We are proud of our achievements in this area; maintaining the Premier League Equality Standard Advanced Level, becoming a founding signatory of the Football Association’s Football Leadership Diversity Code and being recognised as a leader in this important area on and off the pitch. We take our responsibilities in this area seriously and through the work being done across the club, we are committed to increasing the diversity of our people and becoming an increasingly inclusive workplace for all. We are committed to hiring great people representative of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills across our entire business. If you share our enthusiasm and passion for inclusivity, then we want to hear from you.

Liverpool FC is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and vulnerable adults and expects all Colleagues and Volunteers to share this commitment. This role is subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS check.

job.title: Academy- Lead Athletic Development Coach
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW
The Athletic Development Coach will lead the Long-Term Athletic Development (LTAD) program for the Nashville SC Academy in alignment with the High Performance philosophy. This role works closely with High Performance staff across NSC and HCFC to design and implement team and individual programs, both in the gym and on the field, to optimize youth athlete development.
The ideal candidate has coaching or strength & conditioning experience, formal education in exercise physiology or a related field, and expertise in load management for youth soccer.
This position reports to the Director of High Performance and the Head of Athletic Development for the First Team, and collaborates with the Academy Director, Athletic Trainers, and performance staff to support a collaborative, high-performance environment.
This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of elite youth soccer players!
 
RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead and oversee on-field warm-ups, cool-downs, strength training, and prehabilitation sessions, as well as individualized training for targeted or rehabilitating players in collaboration with medical staff.
  • Design and implement individual and team off-season training programs.
  • Foster strong relationships with players and staff to effectively deliver performance programs.
  • Develop educational materials to promote best practices in athletic development and sport performance, aligning with the High Performance department’s initiatives.
  • Organize and maintain field and gym equipment.
  • Travel with the team to games and events as needed.
  • Stay current with the latest research and best practices for future program implementation.
  • Contribute to and enhance LTAD programming, including data collection, testing, analytics, and reporting to optimize youth player performance.
  • Manage player performance data, including distributing devices, processing and inputting data, wellness monitoring, testing administration, RPE collection, analysis, and reporting.
  • Utilize performance monitoring tools and technologies to track player performance and support injury prevention strategies.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Undergraduate (Bachelor’s) Degree from a 4-year accredited University in related field of study such as Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Sport Science, Biomechanics, Strength & Conditioning, and/or similar
  • NSCA-CSCS (Certified Strength & Conditioning Specialist)
  • CPR Certification

PREFERRED

  • Graduate (Master’s) Degree from an accredited University in related field of study
  • 2-3 years experience working with youth soccer within the United States
  • NSCA-CPSS (Certified Performance and Sport Scientist)
  • Functional Movement Screening (FMS) and Selective Functional Movement Assessment (SFMA) Level 1
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Team Operations - Performance Scientist
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

Position Title: Performance Scientist

Department: Team Operations- High Performance

Reports to: Director of High Performance

 

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Performance Scientist supports player availability and performance by leading sport science data operations, monitoring, reporting, and applied insights that inform training, recovery, and return-to-performance decisions. This role reports directly to the Director of High Performance and works in close collaboration to define the path forward for key initiatives. The Performance Scientist will be provided autonomy to determine the best execution plan, while ensuring alignment with coaching, performance, and medical priorities.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own end-to-end sports science data operations (collection, QA/QC, documentation, and governance) across performance data streams.
  • Lead training and match monitoring systems (e.g., STS) and related technologies (GPS, heart rate, VALD, 1080 and others), ensuring reliable workflows and clean outputs.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, models, metrics, and reports that track workload, readiness, and physical performance across the season.
  • Deliver clear, actionable insights to coaches, performance/medical staff, and players (including real-time training feedback when needed).
  • Plan and execute performance testing and assessment protocols (field and gym-based); maintain benchmarks and individualized targets.
  • Collaborate with Athletic Development and Medical on activation, strength/regeneration, and end-stage return-to-performance support as needed.
  • Partner with analytics and scouting on performance questions tied to player evaluation, transactions, and projections.
  • Lead integration of second team and academy performance data into centralized systems, standards, and reporting.
  • Ensure compliance with all MLS medical manual requirements and club policies and procedures.

KEY DELIVERABLES

  • Readiness/availability updates aligned with training plans and performance/medical direction.
  • Stakeholder dashboards and reports with clear KPI definitions and refresh cadence.
  • Testing battery execution and reporting with benchmarks, targets, and action steps.
  • Multi-squad integration outputs (first team/second team/academy) using shared standards and longitudinal tracking.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree in Exercise Science or related field.
  • Certified Performance and Sport Scientist (CPSS).
  • Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS).
  • Minimum 2 years experience in an elite sport environment.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with GPS systems, heart rate, force plates, and current performance technologies.
  • Experience in a coach-facing role explaining monitoring outputs and real-time GPS results.
  • Proficiency in R, Python, and Power BI for data analysis and reporting.
  • Current CPR/AED certification (or ability to obtain promptly).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience querying cloud databases and supporting automated/real-time reporting (e.g., SQL, ETL, APIs).
  • Comfortable conversing in Spanish.
  • Experience scaling sport science systems across multiple squads (first team + second team + academy).
  • Strong data QA habits and reproducible workflows (e.g., documentation, version control).

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Ticketing - Box Office Representative PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
POSITION OVERVIEW
The Ticket Office Representative is a part-time, event-day position responsible for providing exceptional customer service and assisting fans with ticket purchases and inquiries at GEODIS Park. This role plays an important part in delivering a seamless matchday experience by supporting ticket sales, processing transactions, and resolving ticket-related questions. Applicants must reside in the Nashville area.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Process ticket sales through Ticketmaster and assist guests with ticket purchases and ticketing issues.
  • Provide clear, friendly, and professional customer service throughout all interactions.
  • Address general inquiries related to seating options, pricing, stadium policies, and event information.
  • Accurately complete credit card and cash transactions in accordance with Club procedures.
  • Reconcile and balance cash drawers at the end of each shift.
  • Support Box Office leadership with additional duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Prior customer service or ticketing experience preferred, but not required.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to remain professional in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Youth Soccer Coach - Part Time
job.html_description:
Position Summary
Nashville Soccer Club is seeking energetic, reliable, and knowledgeable coaches to support the delivery of its Youth Soccer Programs. This role focuses on camps, clinics, grassroots programming, Academy pathway programs and coach education initiatives across the Nashville community. The role is centered on player development programming within the Youth Soccer Department. Coaches will represent Nashville SC while delivering high-quality soccer experiences that are fun, inclusive, and developmentally appropriate. This position is part-time, with flexible scheduling based on program needs, including evenings, weekends, and seasonal peak periods. Strong performers may be considered for expanded responsibilities or future full-time opportunities within the club. This is not an academy coaching position.

Duties & Responsibilities
  • Deliver engaging and age-appropriate coaching sessions at camps, clinics, and grassroots programs.
  • Implement Nashville SC Youth Soccer curriculum and session plans across all youth programming.
  • Create a positive, safe, and inclusive environment for all participants.
  • Support event operations including setup, check-in, and breakdown of sessions.
  • Serve as a club ambassador, maintaining professionalism with players, parents, and partners.
  • Assist with coaching education sessions and mentorship initiatives when required.
  • Provide feedback on player development and program delivery when requested.
  • Ensure all safety, risk management, and safeguarding standards are followed.
Qualifications
  • Previous coaching experience in youth soccer (recreational, grassroots, or club level required).
  • Passion for working with children and developing players of all ability levels.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours including evenings and weekends.
  • Reliable transportation to program locations across the Greater Nashville area.
  • US Soccer Grassroots (or equivalent) License or higher (or willingness to obtain).
  • Experience working in a youth development environment (Rec, Club, Academy or camps).
  • Background in player development models.
  • Ability to be active for extended periods (standing, running, demonstrating drills)
  • Ability to lift and carry equipment up to 30 lbs

job.title: Soccer Squad (Part-Time)
job.html_description:
Position Summary:
Nashville SC Soccer Squad will serve as community ambassadors for the Club at key community-based events and programs throughout Nashville. This group will be integral to executing community outreach through soccer programming. The Soccer Squad will also serve as an extension of the Community Engagement department by assisting with our core youth soccer programs including Grassroots Soccer, IMPACT Soccer, MNPS P.L.A.Y.S., and more.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Facilitate soccer-specific activations at community engagement events while providing superb customer service and displaying excitement about the organization.
  • Act as an extension of the club’s community engagement department by providing information on various soccer programs.
  • Assist with program set-up and breakdown. 
  • Collect and report valuable feedback and insights after each event to provide back to the team supervisors.
Shift Information:
  • Must be able to work flexible hours including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Some shifts will require picking up materials to transport to the event site, plus setting up and taking down materials.
Qualifications:
  • A general interest and working knowledge of the sport of soccer. 
  • Should be able to answer basic questions about the game, NSC’s schedule and roster, etc.
  • Experience playing the game and coaching youth is preferred but not required.
  • Strong people and communication skills. 
  • Comfortable promoting and interacting with new people at NSC events with a fun and positive attitude.
  • Collaborative personality who works well with others on their team. 
  • Enjoys engaging with team members and is responsive to messages.
  • Must have transportation, a good driving record, and valid driver’s license.
  • Reliable and punctual, being on-time is important to you.
  • Bilingual (English & Spanish) is helpful but not required.
  • Must be able to move and lift a minimum of 50 pounds.
  • Background check is required.

job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW:
The Academy Part-Time Goalkeeper Coach will be responsible for the U14 and U15 academy goalkeepers. The goalkeeper coach will be tasked with constructing and executing individualized goalkeeper sessions as well as assisting head coaches on the field where necessary. This person will work closely with the Academy Goalkeeper coach, as well as academy staff and must adhere to all club and league requirements. job.title: Academy- Assistant Performance Coach PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW
The part-time Assistant Performance Coach for the Nashville SC Academy will be responsible for supporting and assisting the club by providing an integrated High-Performance LTAD program for it’s Academy players, in line with the Club and Performance department philosophy. This position will work closely with the Academy Director, Academy Performance Coach, and Academy Medical Department to create team and player-specific programs and administer those programs on the field and in the gym for developing youth athletes within the Academy. The person in this role should have prior playing and/or coaching experience and be expected to comfortably facilitate soccer-centric programs.  In addition, they should also have a formal educational background in exercise physiology (or similar degree) and load management across a variety of metrics as it relates to the development of youth soccer athletes.  This role will report directly to the Head of Performance for the First Team and will work closely with the Academy Director, Academy Performance Coach and Academy Athletic Trainer, as well as various other key coaches/staff.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • This position will direct and/or assist in the following areas:
  • Assisting, managing and directing on-field warm up and cool down sessions, strength training, prehabilitation, as well as individual sessions for targeted or rehabilitating players in conjunction with medical staff
  • Distribution of player devices and processing data into club systems on a daily basis, along with wellness monitoring, testing administration, RPE collection, compiling, analysis, and reporting
  • Utilizing various monitoring software, tools and technologies to report on player performance and injury prevention
  • Direct and/or assist with the delivery of scientifically based optimal recovery strategies post trining and post-match
  • Help develop and implement individual and/or team off-season programs
  • Help develop strong interpersonal relationships with players and staff to effectively administer programs
  • Help producing educational materials for players to guide towards best practices in the development and optimization of sport performance
  • Organizing and maintaining field and gym equipment
  • Surveying literature and best practices for future implementation
  • Contribute to and advance LTAD programming and curriculum, data collection, testing, analytics, and reporting to develop high-performance in youth players
  • Occasional travel with team to games/events

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Undergraduate (Bachelor’s) Degree from a 4-year accredited University in related field of study such as Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Sport Science, Biomechanics, Strength & Conditioning, and/or similar
  • NSCA-CSCS (Certified Strength & Conditioning Specialist)
  • CPR Certification
PREFERRED
  • Graduate (Master’s) Degree from an accredited University in related field of study
  • 2-3 years experience working with youth soccer within the United States
  • XPS-EXOS Performance Specialist
  • Functional Movement Screening (FMS) – Certified Level 1/2
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English
HOURS
  • 15-20 hours per week
  • Nights and weekend availability
 

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Marketing - Street Team PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
Position Summary
Nashville SC Street Team members serve as key community ambassadors for the Club throughout the 2025 season. This role supports fan engagement at public appearances, home matches, away watch parties, and community events across the Nashville area. Street Team members play a vital role in strengthening fan loyalty by enhancing the matchday and event experience, while also serving as an extension of the Club’s Marketing and Entertainment teams.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Facilitate on-site activations and promotional events while delivering exceptional customer service and representing the Club with energy and professionalism.
  • Serve as an extension of the Marketing Department by promoting club initiatives, ticket programs, and brand messaging.
  • Assist guests as part of the GEODIS Park guest experience team when needed.
  • Actively engage with fans to encourage participation in activations, distribute giveaways, and provide event-specific information.
  • Assist with the setup, operation, and breakdown of interactive displays, promotional booths, and event materials.
  • Distribute marketing collateral in an organized and professional manner.
  • Collect and report feedback, observations, and insights following events to supervisors.
  • Support pre-match activities, including Opening Act activations (e.g., Kick Wall, premium tailgate).
  • Serve as a matchday runner for the Nashville SC Entertainment team as needed.
  • Assist with matchday entertainment management, hospitality, and game presentation needs.
  • Support production logistics, including entertainment personnel arrival, load-in, and load-out.

Shift Information
  • Shifts include all home matches, the majority of away matches, and additional off-site community events throughout the season.
  • Hours vary by event schedule, with an expected commitment of approximately 5–15 hours per week during the season.
  • Some shifts require transporting materials to and from event locations and assisting with setup and teardown.

Qualifications
  • Ability to commit to all Nashville SC matchdays (home and away) with minimal scheduling conflicts.
  • General interest in and working knowledge of soccer, including basic understanding of Nashville SC’s schedule and roster.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a positive, outgoing attitude.
  • Comfortable engaging with fans and promoting club initiatives in public settings.
  • Team-oriented, collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to learn club promotions, ticket programs, and soccer-related information (training provided).
  • Reliable transportation, valid driver’s license, and a good driving record.
  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and select holidays.
  • Dependable, punctual, and professional.
  • Ability to lift and move materials exceeding 50 lbs.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism when interacting with VIP-level personnel.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required.
  • Prior experience in promotions, events, or brand ambassador roles preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.
